quote: your providence, O Father, governeth it: for you have made a way in the sea, and a safe path in the waves.
live_here: But your providence, O Father, governeth it: for you have made a way in the sea, and a safe path in the waves;

note: Wisdom 14:4 — *shewing that you can save from all danger.* The save-from-all-danger architecture; Matt 8:25's *Lord, save us: we perish* walks the same trust-grammar.
quote: shewing that you can save from all danger.
live_here: Shewing that you can save from all danger: yes, though a man went to sea without art.

note: Sirach 35:1 — *he that keepeth the law brings offerings enough.* The wisdom-stream's reframing of sacrifice-substance: keeping the Torah IS bringing offerings enough; the heart-Torah is the offering.
quote: he that keepeth the law brings offerings enough.
live_here: He that keepeth the law brings offerings enough: he that takes heed to the commandment offers a peace offering.

note: Sirach 35:2 — *he that gives alms sacrificeth praise.* Acts of mercy ARE the sacrifice-substance the Tanakh-prophetic stream had been naming; Matt 9:13's Hosea 6:6 citation walks the same.
quote: he that gives alms sacrificeth praise.
live_here: He that requiteth a goodturn offers fine flour; and he that gives alms sacrificeth praise.

note: Sirach 35:3 — *to depart from wickedness is a thing pleasing to Yahuah (God); and to forsake unrighteousness is a propitiation.* The wisdom-stream's atonement-substance: turning-from-wickedness IS propitiation; Matt 9:13's call-to-repentance walks the same.
quote: to depart from wickedness is a thing pleasing to Yahuah (God); and to forsake unrighteousness is a propitiation.
live_here: To depart from wickedness is a thing pleasing to Yahuah (God); and to forsake unrighteousness is a propitiation.

note: Tobit 4:7 — *give alms ... and the face of Yahuah (God) shall not be turned away from you.* The wisdom-stream's alms-with-eye-not-envious architecture; Matt 9:11-13's Pharisaic indignation is the inverse: envy of the mercy extended to the marginalized in the costume of purity-credential.
quote: give alms ... and the face of Yahuah (God) shall not be turned away from you.
live_here: Give alms of your substance; and when you give alms, let not your eye be envious, neither turn your face from any poor, and the face of Yahuah (God) shall not be turned away from you.

note: Tobit 4:9 — *you layest up a good treasure for thyself against the day of necessity.* The alms-as-laid-up-treasure architecture; the Sermon's own *treasures in heaven* (Matt 6:19-20) walks the same; Matt 9:13's Hosea-6:6 citation locks the diagnostic against the Pharisaic-counterfeit.
quote: you layest up a good treasure for thyself against the day of necessity.
live_here: For you layest up a good treasure for thyself against the day of necessity.

note: Tobit 4:10 — *alms do deliver from death, and suffers not to come into darkness.* The wisdom-stream's alms-as-deliverance-architecture; the mercy-substance IS the deliverance-substance.
quote: alms do deliver from death, and suffers not to come into darkness.
live_here: Because that alms do deliver from death, and suffers not to come into darkness.

note: Tobit 12:9 — *alms does deliver from death, and shall purge away all sin.* The angel Raphael's closing instruction names the mercy-substance as the very forgiveness-substance the King exercises at the paralytic's pronouncement (Matt 9:2) and the Mattityahu (Matthew) table (Matt 9:13).
quote: alms does deliver from death, and shall purge away all sin.
live_here: For alms does deliver from death, and shall purge away all sin. Those that exercise alms and righteousness shall be filled with life:

note: Sirach 12:4 — *give to the godly man, and help not a sinner.* The wisdom-stream's discriminating-mercy stance the Pharisaic-counterfeit-righteousness inherited; Matt 9:10's King-at-the-table-with-sinners is the direct-reversal.
quote: give to the godly man, and help not a sinner.
live_here: Give to the godly man, and help not a sinner.

note: Sirach 12:5 — *hold back your bread, and give it not to the ungodly.* The wisdom-stream's explicit instruction the Pharisees at Matt 9:11 are operating under; the King breaks the discriminating-bread-fellowship rule by eating with those Sirach 12 instructed his disciples to hold-back-from.
quote: hold back your bread, and give it not to the ungodly.
live_here: Do well to him that is lowly, but give not to the ungodly: hold back your bread, and give it not to him, lest he overmaster you thereby: for else you shall receive twice as much evil for all the good you shall have done to him.

note: Sirach 12:7 — *give to the good, and help not the sinner.* The wisdom-stream's categorical-exclusion the King reverses at Matt 9:13: *not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance* is the inverse of the Sirach 12 mandate.
quote: give to the good, and help not the sinner.
live_here: Give to the good, and help not the sinner.

note: *And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them. But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?* The Lukan call of Levi and the table-fellowship that follows is the same Sirach-12-inverse the Matthew 9:10 catch names.

Tobit 12:8 — *prayer is good with fasting and alms and righteousness.* The wisdom-stream's prayer-fasting-alms-righteousness triad; Matt 9:14's Pharisaic-fasting-question presupposes the credential-without-the-mercy-triad operative, and the King reframes fasting in the bridegroom-architecture without abolishing it.
quote: prayer is good with fasting and alms and righteousness.
live_here: Prayer is good with fasting and alms and righteousness. A little with righteousness is better than much with unrighteousness. It is better to give alms than to lay up gold:

note: Sirach 34:26 — *the man that fasteth for his sins, and goes again, and doeth the same: who will hear his prayer?* The wisdom-stream's fasting-without-repentance-is-vain diagnostic; Matt 9:15's bridegroom-reframe and *then shall they fast* affirms fasting reframed in the mercy-substance Sirach 34 implied as precondition.
quote: the man that fasteth for his sins, and goes again, and doeth the same: who will hear his prayer?
live_here: So is it with a man that fasteth for his sins, and goes again, and doeth the same: who will hear his prayer? or what does his humbling profit him?

note: Sirach 9:10 — *forsake not an old friend; for the new is not comparable to him.* The wisdom-stream holds the old-vs-new in inverse register to the gospel; the Pharisaic-rabbinic-system's self-justification rests on the wisdom-stream loyalty. The Torah is NEITHER the wine NOR the wineskin; the rabbinic-old-bottle bursts when the heart-Torah-life enters.
quote: forsake not an old friend; for the new is not comparable to him.
live_here: Forsake not an old friend; for the new is not comparable to him: a new friend is as new wine; when it is old, you shall drink it with pleasure.

note: Sirach 38:9 — *in your sickness ... pray to Yahuah (God), and he will make you whole.* The wisdom-stream's prayer-first architecture; the bleeding woman at Matt 9:20 bypasses the prescribed-mediator-chain because the King IS the direct-source the wisdom-stream's prescription pointed toward.
quote: in your sickness ... pray to Yahuah (God), and he will make you whole.
live_here: My son, in your sickness be not negligent: but pray to Yahuah (God), and he will make you whole.

note: Sirach 38:12 — *give place to the physician, for Yahuah (God) has created him.* The wisdom-stream's give-place-to-the-physician prescription; the bleeding woman had given place to physicians for twelve years (Mark 5:26 records the Sirach-38 prescription faithfully followed and failed); the King's direct-touch at Matt 9:22 makes whole what the physician-chain could not.
quote: give place to the physician, for Yahuah (God) has created him.
live_here: Then give place to the physician, for Yahuah (God) has created him: let him not go from you, for you have need of him.

note: Sirach 38:14 — *they shall also pray to Yahuah (God), that he would prosper that, which they give for ease and remedy to prolong life.* The physician's prosper-the-remedy authority depends on the Most High; at Matt 9:25 the King takes the dead girl's hand and exercises the prosper-the-remedy authority directly — the Formed-in-flesh IS the source the physician-chain prays to.
quote: they shall also pray to Yahuah (God), that he would prosper that, which they give for ease and remedy to prolong life.
live_here: For they shall also pray to Yahuah (God), that he would prosper that, which they give for ease and remedy to prolong life.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 16:13 — *you have power of life and death: you leadest to the gates of hell, and bringest up again.* The wisdom-stream's direct architecture of the Most High's power-over-life-and-death; Matt 9:24-25's raising of Yair (Jairus)'s daughter is the in-flesh exercise of the same authority.
quote: you have power of life and death: you leadest to the gates of hell, and bringest up again.
live_here: For you have power of life and death: you leadest to the gates of hell, and bringest up again.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 16:14 — *a man indeed killeth ... the spirit, when it is gone forth, returns not.* The mortal-man-cannot-bring-back diagnostic; the King at Matt 9:25 brings back the spirit that has gone — confirming the Formed-from-the-Formless framework on the nature of Yahusha (Jesus).
quote: a man indeed killeth ... the spirit, when it is gone forth, returns not.
live_here: A man indeed killeth through his malice: and the spirit, when it is gone forth, returns not; neither the soul received up comes again.

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 12:31 — *the lion, whom you sawest rising up out of the wood.* The apocalyptic-stream's lion-rising-out-of-the-wood vision the angel-interpreter identifies as the Messiah-anointed-from-the-seed-of-David at v.32.
quote: the lion, whom you sawest rising up out of the wood.
live_here: And the lion, whom you sawest rising up out of the wood, and roaring, and speaking to the eagle, and rebuking her for her unrighteousness with all the words which you have heard;

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 12:32 — *this is the anointed, which the Highest has kept for them ... to the end.* The lion-figure named as the anointed (Messiah / Christ) kept against the end-of-the-age; Matt 9:27's *Son of David* recognition lands the figure in present-tense.
quote: this is the anointed, which the Highest has kept for them ... to the end.
live_here: This is the anointed, which the Highest has kept for them and for their wickedness to the end: he shall reprove them, and shall upbraid them with their cruelty.

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 12:34 — *for the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders.* The Davidic-Messiah delivers the remnant of the scattered seed with mercy — Hosea 6:6's mercy-substance + the gathering of Matt 9:36 + the Davidic-Messianic recognition of Matt 9:27 are one architecture.
quote: for the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders.
live_here: For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, of which I have spoken to you from the beginning.

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7:28 — *for my son the Messiah shall be revealed.* (Seeded text's "Yahusha (Jesus)" naming at this verse is corrected by this migration to the underlying Syriac's *the Messiah*.) The wisdom-stream's apocalyptic-register confirmation of the Davidic-Messianic figure Matt 9:27's blind men confess.
quote: for my son the Messiah shall be revealed.
live_here: For my son the Messiah shall be revealed with those that be with him, and they that remain shall rejoice within four hundred years.

note: 2 Baruch 35:1 — *the days come, and it shall be when the time of the age has ripened, and the harvest of its evil and good seeds has come.* The apocalyptic-stream names the harvest of the age explicitly; Matt 9:37's *the harvest truly is plenteous* names the present-tense fulfillment at the King's arrival.

2 Baruch 35:1 (extended) — the same eschatological-harvest-of-the-age verse also anchors Matt 9:38's *pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers.* The Lord-of-the-harvest is the Mighty One the apocalyptic-stream had named; the labourers being prayed-for are about to be commissioned at Matt 10:1.

2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:35 — *the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when comes the fruit of the floor of our reward?* The wisdom-stream's how-long-until-the-harvest question; Matt 9:37 names the answer in present-tense.
quote: the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when comes the fruit of the floor of our reward?
live_here: Did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when comes the fruit of the floor of our reward?

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:36 — *even when the number of seeds is filled in you: for he has weighed the world in the balance.* The harvest is timed to the fulness of the seed-count; Matt 9:38's prayer-for-labourers is the kingdom-citizens' participation in the seed-filling.
quote: even when the number of seeds is filled in you: for he has weighed the world in the balance.
live_here: And to these things Uriel the archangel gave them answer, and said, Even when the number of seeds is filled in you: for he has weighed the world in the balance.

note: 2 Baruch 38:4 — *all we the twelve tribes are bound by one bond, inasmuch as we are born from one father.* The apocalyptic-stream's twelve-tribes-bound-by-one-bond architecture; the scattered-shepherdless multitudes Yahusha (Jesus) sees at Matt 9:36 are the same one-father-born twelve-tribe-body the wisdom-stream had named.

2 Baruch 38:7 — *with much mercy will gather together again those who were dispersed.* The apocalyptic-stream's explicit gathering-of-the-dispersed-with-much-mercy architecture; the same mercy-substance Hosea 6:6 names at Matt 9:13, now operative as the gathering-architecture of Matt 9:36's scattered-shepherdless multitudes.

2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 13:40 — *those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners ... whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive.* The wisdom-stream identifies the Assyrian-captivity ten tribes as the body the dispersion carried; Matt 10:6's lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) names the same body.
quote: those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners ... whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive.
live_here: Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 13:41 — *they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country ... that they might there keep their statutes.* The post-Assyrian-captivity remnant carried covenant-identity into the dispersion-territories; Matt 10:6's mission-scope is to the same body in those territories.
quote: they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country ... that they might there keep their statutes.
live_here: But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt,

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 13:47 — *the Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through.* The latter-time gathering-of-the-ten-tribes through the parted-stream architecture; Matt 10:23's *till the Son of Adam be come* names the present-age standing-mission walking toward the wisdom-stream's named terminus.
quote: the Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through.
live_here: The Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest you the multitude with peace.

note: Tobit 13:5 — *he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations.* The wisdom-stream's scourge-mercy-gathering architecture; the same gathering-mission Matt 10:6 commissions.
quote: he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations.
live_here: And he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us.

note: Tobit 13:3 — *confess him before the Gentiles, you children of Yashar'el (Israel): for he has scattered us among them.* The wisdom-stream's direct instruction; Matt 10:32's *whosoever therefore shall confess me before men* walks the same architecture at the kingdom-citizens level.
quote: confess him before the Gentiles, you children of Yashar'el (Israel): for he has scattered us among them.
live_here: Confess him before the Gentiles, you children of Yashar'el (Israel): for he has scattered us among them.

note: Tobit 14:5 — *they shall return from all places of their captivity, and build up Yerushalayim (Jerusalem) gloriously.* The multi-stage gathering-architecture: FIRST post-Babylon return, THEN latter-time return from all places of the captivity. Matt 10:23's standing-mission is the present-age work between the two stages.
quote: they shall return from all places of their captivity, and build up Yerushalayim (Jerusalem) gloriously.
live_here: And that again Yahuah (God) will have mercy on them, and bring them again into the land, where they shall build a temple, but not like to the first, until the time of that age be fulfilled; and afterward they shall return from all places of their captivity, and build up Jerusalem gloriously, and the house of Yahuah (God) shall be built in it for ever with a glorious building, as the prophets have spoken thereof.

note: Sirach 2:1 — *if you come to serve Yahuah (God), prepare your soul for temptation. Set your heart aright, and constantly endure.* The wisdom-stream's direct disciple-preparation-for-trial architecture; Matt 10:22's endure-to-the-end walks the same.
quote: if you come to serve Yahuah (God), prepare your soul for temptation. Set your heart aright, and constantly endure.
live_here: My son, if you come to serve Yahuah (God), prepare your soul for temptation.

note: Sirach 2:5 — *gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.* The wisdom-stream's adversity-as-refining-furnace; the trial-as-proving the King at Matt 10:22 names at the apostolic-mission persecution-encounter.
quote: gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.
live_here: For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.

note: Sirach 2:18 — *we will fall into the hands of Yahuah (God), and not into the hands of men.* The wisdom-stream's fear-redirect: choose to fall into Yahuah's hands rather than men's. Matt 10:28's fear-redirect walks the same architecture with the eschatological-stakes made explicit.
quote: we will fall into the hands of Yahuah (God), and not into the hands of men.
live_here: Saying, We will fall into the hands of Yahuah (God), and not into the hands of men: for as his majesty is, so is his mercy.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 — *the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.* The wisdom-stream's direct operative-fact for Matt 10:28's *not able to kill the soul* — the persecutors reach the body but cannot reach the soul that is held in the Father's hand.
quote: the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.
live_here: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 3:5 — *having been a little chastised, they shall be greatly rewarded: for Yahuah (God) proved them, and found them worthy.* The wisdom-stream's suffering-as-proving architecture; Matt 10:22's endure-to-the-end perseverance-frame names the same diagnostic from the kingdom-citizens side.
quote: having been a little chastised, they shall be greatly rewarded: for Yahuah (God) proved them, and found them worthy.
live_here: And having been a little chastised, they shall be greatly rewarded: for Yahuah (God) proved them, and found them worthy for himself.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:1 — *then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him.* The wisdom-stream's eschatological-vindication architecture; Matt 10:32's confess-me-before-men leads into the same Father-judgment-recognition register where the persecuted stands in boldness before the persecutors.
quote: then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him.
live_here: Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him, and made no account of his labours.

note: 4 Maccabees (edition ch 8, v.4 = std 4 Macc 9:4) — *apply it to this body of mine; for my soul ye cannot reach, not if ye would.* The Hebrew library's most direct verbal-anchor for Matt 10:28's *not able to kill the soul* — the third son under torture names the diagnostic explicitly at the martyrdom-witness.

4 Maccabees (edition ch 11, v.3 = std 4 Macc 15:3) — *her seven sons ... loved rather religion, which saveth unto eternal life according to Elohim (God).* The priority of eternal-stakes-religion over the tyrant's present-life-promise; Matt 10:28's fear-redirect names the same priority at the commissioning.

4 Maccabees (edition ch 13, v.13 = std 4 Macc 17:13) — *virtue, proving them through endurance, set before them the prize of victory in incorruption in everlasting life.* The wisdom-stream's endurance-prize architecture; Matt 10:22's endure-to-the-end is the same diagnostic at the kingdom-citizens commissioning.

4 Maccabees (edition ch 13, v.18 = std 4 Macc 17:18) — *the endurance, whereby they now do both stand beside the throne of Elohim (God) and live the blessed age.* The wisdom-stream's post-martyrdom station; the Red Line #11 first-resurrection-firstfruits architecture at the wisdom-stream witness.

4 Maccabees (edition ch 8, v.18 = std 4 Macc 9:18) — *even if thou dost remove my organ of speech, Elohim (God) is a hearer also of the speechless.* The wisdom-stream's direct operative-fact for Matt 10:20's *Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you* — the Father's direct-hearing of the persecuted-disciple does not depend on the disciple's organ of speech.

2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:33 — *how, and when shall these things come to pass? wherefore are our years few and evil?* The wisdom-stream's prophet-timing-question architecture; Yochanan (John) at Matt 11:3 walks the same legitimate-clarification-seek under the inaugurated-but-not-yet tension.
quote: how, and when shall these things come to pass? wherefore are our years few and evil?
live_here: Then I answered and said, How, and when shall these things come to pass? wherefore are our years few and evil?

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:34 — *do not you hasten above the most Highest.* The angel commends the trust-the-timeline disposition; Matt 11:6 names the blessing on the one who endures the gap without falling away.
quote: do not you hasten above the most Highest.
live_here: And he answered me, saying, Do not you hasten above the most Highest: for your haste is in vain to be above him, for you have much exceeded.

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:35 — *souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long?* The souls-of-the-righteous-in-their-chambers-asking-how-long architecture; the same pattern Revelation 6:9-11 names at the souls-under-the-altar restatement; Matt 11:6 names the blessing on the disposition that endures the gap.
quote: souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long?
live_here: Did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when comes the fruit of the floor of our reward?

note: Sirach 48:10 — *ordained for reproofs in their times ... to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.* THE strongest wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Eliyahu-pattern with the twelve-tribe-gathering substance (Red Line #11) integrated; Matt 11:14 names the inaugural-fulfillment in Yochanan (John).
quote: ordained for reproofs in their times ... to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.
live_here: Who were ordained for reproofs in their times, to pacify the wrath of the judgment of Yahuah (God), before it brake forth into fury, and to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.

note: 1 Maccabees 2:58 — *Elias for being zealous and fervent for the law was taken up into heaven.* The wisdom-stream's witness to the Eliyahu-zealous-for-the-Torah architecture; Yochanan (John) at Matt 11:14 walks the same disposition at the messenger-before-the-King's-face register.
quote: Elias for being zealous and fervent for the law was taken up into heaven.
live_here: Elias for being zealous and fervent for the law was taken up into heaven.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 2:12 — *let us lie in wait for the righteous ... he upbraideth us with our offending the law.* The wisdom-stream's direct prophecy of the system's-rejection-of-the-righteous-one; Matt 11:18-19's children-in-marketplaces names the operative-form at the apostolic-mission level.
quote: let us lie in wait for the righteous ... he upbraideth us with our offending the law.
live_here: Therefore let us lie in wait for the righteous; because he is not for our turn, and he is clean contrary to our doings: he upbraideth us with our offending the law, and objecteth to our infamy the transgressings of our education.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 2:15 — *his life is not like other men's, his ways are of another fashion.* The aesthetic-rejection of the righteous-one the wisdom-stream named; Matt 11:19's *gluttonous-man, winebibber, friend-of-publicans-and-sinners* slander is the operative-form.
quote: his life is not like other men's, his ways are of another fashion.
live_here: He is grievous to us even to behold: for his life is not like other men’s, his ways are of another fashion.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 2:20 — *let us condemn him with a shameful death.* The wisdom-stream's prophecy of the trajectory's terminus; Matt 11:19's slander is the early-step the Matt 12:24 Beelzebul-attribution and the Matt 26-27 cross-trial walk through.
quote: let us condemn him with a shameful death.
live_here: Let us condemn him with a shameful death: for by his own saying he shall be respected.

note: Sirach 24:19 — *come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.* The wisdom-stream's wisdom-figure come-unto-me invitation-substance; Matt 11:19's *wisdom is justified of her children* names the body responding to the same invitation.
quote: come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.
live_here: Come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.

note: Baruch 3:36 — *he has found out all the way of knowledge, and has given it to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved.* The wisdom-given to the covenant-seed; the children-of-wisdom at Matt 11:19 are the covenant-seed responding to the wisdom-given.
quote: he has found out all the way of knowledge, and has given it to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved.
live_here: He has found out all the way of knowledge, and has given it to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved.

note: Baruch 4:1 — *this is the book of the commandments of Yahuah (God), and the law that endureth for ever.* The wisdom-given is the Torah; the children-of-wisdom at Matt 11:19 are the kingdom-citizens-who-keep-the-commandments (1 John 2:3-4 filter).
quote: this is the book of the commandments of Yahuah (God), and the law that endureth for ever.
live_here: This is the book of the commandments of Yahuah (God), and the law that endureth for ever: all they that keep it shall come to life; but such as leave it shall die.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 6:5 — *a sharp judgment shall be to them that be in high places.* The wisdom-stream's graduated-accountability-by-credentialing principle; Matt 11:21-22 names the operative-application to the Galilean-cities-of-the-credentialing.
quote: a sharp judgment shall be to them that be in high places.
live_here: Horribly and speedily shall he come upon you: for a sharp judgment shall be to them that be in high places.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 6:6 — *mercy will soon pardon the meanest: but mighty men shall be mightily tormented.* The wisdom-stream's direct statement of graduated-accountability; Matt 11:22's *more tolerable for Tyre and Tsidon (Sidon)* names the operative-application.
quote: mercy will soon pardon the meanest: but mighty men shall be mightily tormented.
live_here: For mercy will soon pardon the meanest: but mighty men shall be mightily tormented.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 6:8 — *a sore trial shall come upon the mighty.* The wisdom-stream's sore-trial-upon-the-mighty; Matt 11:23's Kfar-Nachum (Capernaum) is the *exalted-unto-heaven* mighty under the sore-trial.
quote: a sore trial shall come upon the mighty.
live_here: But a sore trial shall come upon the mighty.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 10:7 — *the waste land that smoketh is a testimony, and ... a standing pillar of salt is a monument of an unbelieving soul.* The wisdom-stream's enduring-monument-to-judgment; Matt 11:24's *more tolerable for the land of Sodom* invokes the abiding-witness as the floor against which the credentialed-cities are weighed.
quote: the waste land that smoketh is a testimony, and ... a standing pillar of salt is a monument of an unbelieving soul.
live_here: Of whose wickedness even to this day the waste land that smoketh is a testimony, and plants bearing fruit that never come to ripeness: and a standing pillar of salt is a monument of an unbelieving soul.

note: Sirach 3:18 — *the greater you are, the more humble thyself, and you shall find favour before Yahuah (God).* The wisdom-stream's architectural-logic for the revelation-economy; humility-before-Yahuah (God) is the precondition for the favour-channel.
quote: the greater you are, the more humble thyself, and you shall find favour before Yahuah (God).
live_here: The greater you are, the more humble thyself, and you shall find favour before Yahuah (God).

note: Sirach 3:19 — *many are in high place, and of renown: but mysteries are revealed to the meek.* THE strongest extras-tier verbal-anchor for Matt 11:25's *hid from the wise and prudent, revealed unto babes* — the precise inverse-pair the King names at Matt 11:25.
quote: many are in high place, and of renown: but mysteries are revealed to the meek.
live_here: Many are in high place, and of renown: but mysteries are revealed to the meek.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 7:7 — *I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon Yahuah (God), and the spirit of wisdom came to me.* The wisdom-stream's prayer-channel for the Spirit-of-wisdom; Matt 11:25-27's Father-Son revelation-economy operates through the King's prayer.
quote: I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon Yahuah (God), and the spirit of wisdom came to me.
live_here: Wherefore I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon Yahuah (God), and the spirit of wisdom came to me.

note: Sirach 51:23 — *draw near to me, you unlearned, and dwell in the house of learning.* The wisdom-stream wisdom-figure's come-unto-me invitation-substance; the typological-anchor of Matt 11:28's King's invitation to the labour-and-heavy-laden.
quote: draw near to me, you unlearned, and dwell in the house of learning.
live_here: Draw near to me, you unlearned, and dwell in the house of learning.

note: Sirach 51:26 — *put your neck under the yoke, and let your soul receive instruction.* THE direct verbal-anchor for Matt 11:29's *take my yoke upon you, and learn of me*; the framework's exchange-the-Pharisaic-burden-yoke-for-the-King's-rest-yoke reading anchored here.
quote: put your neck under the yoke, and let your soul receive instruction.
live_here: Put your neck under the yoke, and let your soul receive instruction: she is hard at hand to find.

note: Sirach 51:27 — *behold with your eyes, how that I have but little labour, and have gotten to me much rest.* THE direct verbal-anchor for Matt 11:30's *for my yoke is easy, and my burden is light*; the wisdom-stream wisdom-yoke and the King's heart-Torah-yoke are the same yoke-substance.
quote: behold with your eyes, how that I have but little labour, and have gotten to me much rest.
live_here: Behold with your eyes, how that I have but little labour, and have gotten to me much rest.

note: Sirach 6:28 — *at the last you shall find her rest, and that shall be turned to your joy.* The second Sirach yoke-passage (Sirach 6:24-31) naming the rest-yielded-by-the-yoke-of-wisdom architecture; the same shape Matt 11:29's *ye shall find rest unto your souls* walks.
quote: at the last you shall find her rest, and that shall be turned to your joy.
live_here: For at the last you shall find her rest, and that shall be turned to your joy.

note: Sirach 24:19 — *come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.* The third major wisdom-figure-come-unto-me invitation in Sirach (after chapters 6 and 51); Matt 11:28's *come unto me, all ye that labour* walks the same universal-invitation-architecture.
quote: come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.
live_here: Come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.

note: 1 Maccabees 2:41 — the Hasmonean Shabbat-defense decision; life-saving-overrides-Shabbat-restriction as the operative-principle the wisdom-stream itself had locked. Matt 12:11-12's *kal vachomer* sheep-rescue argument walks the same architecture.

Sirach 35:1 — *he that keepeth the law bringeth offerings enough.* The wisdom-stream's direct mercy-substance-IS-the-true-sacrifice architecture; the same Hosea 6:6 diagnostic the King cites at Matt 12:7.
quote: he that keepeth the law bringeth offerings enough.
live_here: He that keepeth the law brings offerings enough: he that takes heed to the commandment offers a peace offering.

note: Sirach 34:18 — *if a man offereth a sacrifice of a thing wrongfully gotten, his offering is ridiculous.* The wisdom-stream's heart-substance-required-for-the-sacrifice-to-be-accepted architecture; the Pharisaic-fence-adherence-without-mercy is the rejected-offering.
quote: if a man offereth a sacrifice of a thing wrongfully gotten, his offering is ridiculous.
live_here: He that sacrificeth of a thing wrongfully gotten, his offering is ridiculous; and the gifts of unjust men are not accepted.

note: Tobit 4:10 — *alms doth deliver from death, and shall not suffer thee to come into darkness.* THE strongest wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the mercy-as-substance-with-eternal-weight architecture.
quote: alms doth deliver from death, and shall not suffer thee to come into darkness.
live_here: Because that alms do deliver from death, and suffers not to come into darkness.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:1 — *the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him.* The wisdom-stream's direct eschatological-reversal-of-the-righteous-condemned architecture; Matt 12:14's council-to-destroy walks toward the same architecture's vindication-day.
quote: the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him.
live_here: Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him, and made no account of his labours.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:4 — *we fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honour.* The wisdom-stream's system's-belated-recognition architecture; the Pharisaic-system at Matt 12:14 walks the inaugurated-step that the day-of-judgment reverses.
quote: we fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honour.
live_here: We fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honour:

note: Sirach 4:1 — *defraud not the poor of his living, and make not the needy eyes to wait long.* The wisdom-stream's kingdom-citizens' bruised-reed-mercy disposition; the King at Matt 12:20 walks the same substance in his ministry.
quote: defraud not the poor of his living, and make not the needy eyes to wait long.
live_here: My son, defraud not the poor of his living, and make not the needy eyes to wait long.

note: Sirach 4:4 — *reject not the supplication of the afflicted; neither turn away thy face from a poor man.* The wisdom-stream's compassion-disposition required of the kingdom-citizens; the King's bruised-reed-mercy at Matt 12:20 walks the same disposition.
quote: reject not the supplication of the afflicted; neither turn away thy face from a poor man.
live_here: Reject not the supplication of the afflicted; neither turn away your face from a poor man.

note: Sirach 35:13 — *he will not despise the supplication of the fatherless; nor the widow, when she poureth out her complaint.* THE strongest wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the cry-of-the-bruised-heard-by-Yahuah (God) architecture.
quote: he will not despise the supplication of the fatherless; nor the widow, when she poureth out her complaint.
live_here: He will not accept any person against a poor man, but will hear the prayer of the oppressed.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 12:10 — *not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed.* The wisdom-stream's cogitation-that-would-never-be-changed architecture; the blasphemy's hardened-disposition is the operative-form.
quote: not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed.
live_here: But executing your judgments upon them by little and little, you gavest them place of repentance, not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed.

note: Sirach 27:6 — *the fruit declareth if the tree have been dressed; so is the utterance of a conceit in the heart of man.* THE strongest wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for Matt 12:33-35's tree-by-fruit / out-of-the-abundance-of-the-heart architecture.
quote: the fruit declareth if the tree have been dressed; so is the utterance of a conceit in the heart of man.
live_here: The fruit declareth if the tree have been dressed; so is the utterance of a conceit in the heart of man.

note: Sirach 27:7 — *praise no man before thou hearest him speak; for this is the trial of men.* The wisdom-stream's speech-as-trial-of-men architecture; the day-of-judgment at Matt 12:36 is the cosmic-version.
quote: praise no man before thou hearest him speak; for this is the trial of men.
live_here: Praise no man before you hear him speak; for this is the trial of men.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 1:11 — *no word so secret, that shall go for nought: and the mouth that belieth slayeth the soul.* The wisdom-stream's no-word-goes-for-nought-and-the-mouth-that-belieth-slays-the-soul architecture; the day-of-judgment substance of Matt 12:36-37.
quote: no word so secret, that shall go for nought: and the mouth that belieth slayeth the soul.
live_here: Therefore beware of murmuring, which is unprofitable; and refrain your tongue from backbiting: for there is no word so secret, that shall go for nought: and the mouth that belieth slayeth the soul.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 16:13 — *thou hast power of life and death: thou leadest to the gates of Sheol, and bringest up again.* The wisdom-stream's gates-of-Sheol-and-bring-up-again architecture; Matt 12:40's three-days-in-the-heart-of-the-earth is the operative-application.
quote: thou hast power of life and death: thou leadest to the gates of Sheol, and bringest up again.
live_here: For you have power of life and death: you leadest to the gates of hell, and bringest up again.

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7:48 — *O Adam, what hast thou done? for though it was thou that sinned, thou art not fallen alone, but we all that come of thee.* The wisdom-stream's inherited-from-Adam evil-heart architecture; the empty-house parable diagnoses the operative-vulnerability.
quote: O Adam, what hast thou done? for though it was thou that sinned, thou art not fallen alone, but we all that come of thee.
live_here: O you Adam, what have you done? for though it was you that sinned, you are not fallen alone, but we all that come of you.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 2:13 — *he calleth himself the child of Yahuah (the Lord) ... his life is not like other men's, his ways are of another fashion.* The wisdom-stream's child-of-Elohim-by-righteous-disposition architecture; Matt 12:50's kingdom-family-recognition criterion walks the same substance.
quote: he calleth himself the child of Yahuah (the Lord) ... his life is not like other men's, his ways are of another fashion.
live_here: He professeth to have the knowledge of Yahuah (God): and he calls himself the child of Yahuah (God).

note: Wisdom of Solomon 2:18 — *if the just man be the son of Elohim (God), he will help him.* The wisdom-stream's son-of-Elohim-tested-by-deliverance architecture; Matt 12:50's kingdom-family is identified by the same heart-Torah-walking life.
quote: if the just man be the son of Elohim (God), he will help him.
live_here: For if the just man be the son of Yahuah (God), he will help him, and deliver him from the hand of his enemies.

note: Sirach 4:10 — *be as a father unto the fatherless ... so shalt thou be as the son of the most High.* THE strongest wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the doing-the-Father's-substance-makes-thee-a-son architecture; Matt 12:50's kingdom-family is the operative-application.
quote: be as a father unto the fatherless ... so shalt thou be as the son of the most High.
live_here: Be as a father to the fatherless, and instead of an husband to their mother: so shall you be as the son of the Most High, and he shall love you more than your mother does.

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 5:9 — *understanding withdraw itself into his secret chamber, And shall be sought of many, and yet not be found.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the understanding-withdrawing-from-the-rejecting-disposition architecture; the system-rejecting-disposition at Matt 13:13-15 encounters the withdrawn-understanding.
quote: understanding withdraw itself into his secret chamber, And shall be sought of many, and yet not be found.
live_here: And salt waters shall be found in the sweet, and all friends shall destroy one another; then shall wit hide itself, and understanding withdraw itself into his secret chamber,

note: Wisdom of Solomon 1:4 — *into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject unto sin.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the wisdom-shall-not-enter-the-malicious-soul architecture; the Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 6:9-10 hardening-citation at Matt 13:13-15 names the operative-form.
quote: into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject unto sin.
live_here: For into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject to sin.

note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 39:6 — *when the great Lord will, he shall be filled with the spirit of understanding: he shall pour out wise sentences.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the spirit-of-understanding-poured-out-on-the-elect-scribe; Matt 13:16-17's blessed-eyes-and-blessed-ears substance carries the same architecture.
quote: when the great Lord will, he shall be filled with the spirit of understanding: he shall pour out wise sentences.
live_here: When the great Yahuah (God) will, he shall be filled with the spirit of understanding: he shall pour out wise sentences, and give thanks to Yahuah (God) in his prayer.

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:30 — *the grain of evil seed hath been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning ... until the time of threshing shall come.* THE direct wisdom-stream parallel to the wheat-and-tares architecture at the heart-of-Adam register; the time-of-threshing is the same harvest the King's parable names.
quote: the grain of evil seed hath been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning ... until the time of threshing shall come.
live_here: For the grain of evil seed has been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning, and how much ungodliness has it brought up to this time? and how much shall it yet bring forth until the time of threshing come?

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 3:21 — *the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed, and was overcome; and so be all they that are born of him.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the wicked-heart-inherited-from-Adam architecture; preserves the actor's-responsibility (while men slept) without erasing it; the framework reads WITHOUT the Augustinian-original-sin-doctrinal-overlay.
quote: the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed, and was overcome; and so be all they that are born of him.
live_here: For the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed, and was overcome; and so be all they that are born of him.

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 8:6 — *give us seed unto our heart, and culture to our understanding, that there may come fruit of it.* The wisdom-stream's prayer-for-seed-unto-the-heart; the prayer's disposition IS the good-ground-soil at Matt 13:23; the Sower's sowing IS the answer to the wisdom-stream's prayer.
quote: give us seed unto our heart, and culture to our understanding, that there may come fruit of it.
live_here: O Yahuah (God), if you suffer not your servant, that we may pray before you, and you give us seed to our heart, and culture to our understanding, that there may come fruit of it; how shall each man live that is corrupt, who bears the place of a man?

note: Wisdom of Solomon 3:7 — *in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.* The wisdom-stream's articulation at the visitation-of-the-righteous register; the sparks-among-the-stubble carries the harvest-and-burning imagery directly — the same harvest the King's parable names.
quote: in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.
live_here: And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 6:22 — *I will tell you, and will not hide mysteries from you; but will seek her out from the beginning of her nativity, and bring the knowledge of her into light.* The wisdom-stream's commitment-to-reveal-the-mysteries operates in the same register the King's parables-method enacts.
quote: I will tell you, and will not hide mysteries from you; but will seek her out from the beginning of her nativity, and bring the knowledge of her into light.
live_here: As for wisdom, what she is, and how she came up, I will tell you, and will not hide mysteries from you: but will seek her out from the beginning of her nativity, and bring the knowledge of her into light, and will not pass over the truth.

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 6:26 — *the truth, which hath been so long without fruit, shall be declared.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the truth-revealed-after-long-hiddenness; the latter-days substance the King's parables-method enacts in operative-form.
quote: the truth, which hath been so long without fruit, shall be declared.
live_here: And the men that are received shall see it, who have not tasted death from their birth: and the heart of the inhabitants shall be changed, and turned into another meaning.

note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 20:30 — *wisdom that is hid, and treasure that is hoarded up, what profit is in them both?* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the hidden-treasure-and-finding-and-obtaining substance; Matt 13:44's treasure-hid-in-the-field names the operative-form at the kingdom-of-heaven register.
quote: wisdom that is hid, and treasure that is hoarded up, what profit is in them both?
live_here: Wisdom that is hid, and treasure that is hoarded up, what profit is in them both?

note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 6:14 — *a faithful friend is a strong defence: and he that hath found such an one hath found a treasure. Nothing doth countervail a faithful friend.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the supreme-worth-substance the buyer pays-all-to-obtain; Matt 13:45-46 names the operative-form at the pearl-of-great-price register.
quote: a faithful friend is a strong defence: and he that hath found such an one hath found a treasure. Nothing doth countervail a faithful friend.
live_here: A faithfull friend is a strong defence: and he that has found such an one has found a treasure.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 7:8 — *I preferred her before sceptres and thrones, and esteemed riches nothing in comparison of her ... all gold in respect of her is as a little sand.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the wisdom-preferred-above-all-else; the buyer (per the framework's preferred Father-Son-buyer reading) prefers-the-pearl-above-all-else and pays-the-full-price-to-obtain.
quote: I preferred her before sceptres and thrones, and esteemed riches nothing in comparison of her ... all gold in respect of her is as a little sand.
live_here: I preferred her before sceptres and thrones, and esteemed riches nothing in comparison of her.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 7:14 — *she is a treasure unto men that never faileth.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the never-failing-treasure substance; the treasure-hid-in-the-field at Matt 13:44 carries the same supreme-worth at the kingdom-of-heaven register.
quote: she is a treasure unto men that never faileth.
live_here: For she is a treasure to men that never fails: which they that use become the friends of Yahuah (God), being commended for the gifts that come from learning.

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7:33 — *the Most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment ... judgment only shall remain, truth shall stand, and faith shall wax strong.* The seat of judgment at the last end, after the reign; the angels severing the wicked from among the just at Matt 13:49 is the severing at the end of the age, before the reign.
quote: the Most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment ... judgment only shall remain, truth shall stand, and faith shall wax strong.
live_here: And the Most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment, and misery shall pass away, and the long suffering shall have an end:

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 8:3 — *many be created, but few shall be saved.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the few-shall-be-saved architecture; the dragnet-of-every-kind gathered + the few-saved-at-the-shore-sorting operate in one architecture.
quote: many be created, but few shall be saved.
live_here: There be many created, but few shall be saved.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 3:8 — *they shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people.* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the righteous-judge-the-nations at the eschatological-end-point; the kingdom-of-priests destination per Red Line #7 at the millennial-reign.
quote: they shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people.
live_here: They shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people, and their Elohim (God) shall reign for ever.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 2:24 — *through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the devil-as-source-of-death architecture; the children-of-the-wicked-one at Matt 13:38-39 are they-that-hold-of-his-side, walking the architecture the wisdom-stream had named.
quote: through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it.
live_here: Nevertheless through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it.

note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 48:1 — *then stood up Eliyahu (Elias) the prophet as fire, and his word burned like a lamp.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Eliyahu-pattern prophet's-fiery-zeal-at-the-royal-court architecture Yochanan (John)'s Torah-confrontation of Herod-Antipas at Matt 14:3-4 enacts.
quote: then stood up Eliyahu (Elias) the prophet as fire, and his word burned like a lamp.
live_here: Then stood up Elias the prophet as fire, and his word burned like a lamp.

note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 48:2 — *who brought a sore famine upon them, and by his zeal he diminished their number.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Eliyahu-pattern judgment-on-the-Torah-violating-court substance; Yochanan (John)'s confrontation of Herod-Antipas's Torah-violation operates in the same architecture (the famine-judgment at 1 Melakhim (Kings) 17:1 parallels the imprisonment-and-eventual-martyrdom at Matt 14:3-12).
quote: who brought a sore famine upon them, and by his zeal he diminished their number.
live_here: He brought a sore famine upon them, and by his zeal he diminished their number.

note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 48:10 — *who wast ordained for reproofs in their times ... and to turn the heart of the father unto the son, and to restore the tribes of Ya'aqov (Jacob).* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Malakhi (Malachi) 4:5-6 Eliyahu-promised-return substance; the Matt 11:14 identification of Yochanan (John) as the first-Eliyahu-coming preparing-for-the-King operates in the architecture Sirach 48:10 had named. The restoration-of-the-tribes-of-Ya'aqov (Jacob) is the framework's scattered-seed-gathering substance the wisdom-stream knew at the Eliyahu-pattern register.
quote: who wast ordained for reproofs in their times ... and to turn the heart of the father unto the son, and to restore the tribes of Ya'aqov (Jacob).
live_here: Who were ordained for reproofs in their times, to pacify the wrath of the judgment of Yahuah (God), before it brake forth into fury, and to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.

note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 48:11 — *blessed are they that saw thee, and slept in love; for we shall surely live.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Eliyahu-pattern prophet's-disciples-blessed-in-the-prophet's-departure substance; Yochanan (John)'s-disciples honor the architecture at Matt 14:12 (the burial-after-the-beheading and the going-to-tell-Yahusha (Jesus)) — the disciples drawn-into-the-King's-orbit as the operative-form of the architecture.
quote: blessed are they that saw thee, and slept in love; for we shall surely live.
live_here: Blessed are they that saw you, and slept in love; for we shall surely live.

note: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 1:19 — *I gave you angels' food to eat in your hunger; and when ye thirsted, I clave the rock, and waters flowed out to your fill.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Father's-wilderness-feeding-of-the-multitude architecture the King recapitulates at Matt 14:13-21 without mediation.
quote: I gave you angels' food to eat in your hunger; and when ye thirsted, I clave the rock, and waters flowed out to your fill.
live_here: Then had I pity upon your mournings, and gave you manna to eat; so you did eat angels’ bread.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 16:20 — *thou feddest thine own people with angels' food, and didst send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man's delight, and agreeing to every taste.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the wilderness-manna substance the King at Matt 14:19 enacts at the Galilee-desert-place; the Yochanan (John) 6 *I am the bread of life* discourse following the Yochanan-account locks the King as the bread-from-heaven the wisdom-stream had named.
quote: thou feddest thine own people with angels' food, and didst send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man's delight, and agreeing to every taste.
live_here: Instead of which you feddest your own people with angels’ food, and did send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man’s delight, and agreeing to every taste.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 16:26 — *it is not the growing of fruits that nourisheth man: but that it is thy word, which preserveth them that put their trust in thee.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the bread-of-life-is-the-Word-of-Yahuah substance the Yochanan (John) 6:63 discourse explicitly anchors (*the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life*); the feeding-substance at Matt 14:19 points beyond-the-loaves to the Word-of-the-King.
quote: it is not the growing of fruits that nourisheth man: but that it is thy word, which preserveth them that put their trust in thee.
live_here: That your children, O Yahuah (God), whom you lovest, might know, that it is not the growing of fruits that nourishes man: but that it is your word, which preserves them that put their trust in you.

note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 24:19 — *come unto me, all ye that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the wisdom-feeding-her-children invitation; the King's come-unto-me invitation across his ministry (Matt 11:28) is the operative-form, with the Matt 14:20 *they did all eat, and were filled* enacting the substance at the Galilee-desert-place.
quote: come unto me, all ye that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.
live_here: Come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.

note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 43:23 — *by his counsel he appeaseth the deep, and planteth islands therein.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Creator's-counsel-appeasing-the-deep architecture; the Tanakh-direct-substance of Iyov (Job) 9:8 (*treadeth upon the waves of the sea*) names the action, Sirach 43:23 names the authority-behind-the-action, the King at Matt 14:25 enacts both at once.

Luke carries the substitutionary-atoning-blood architecture with synoptic substance — the King silent before his accusers, the mockery from those who pass by, the *if thou be the King of the Yahudim (Jews), save thyself* (v.37), and the death-as-faithful-unto-death the 4 Maccabees prefiguring names.

note: 2 Esdras 9:33 — *yet they that received it perished, because they kept not the thing that was sown in them.* The keeping-or-perishing verdict; Luke 8:15's good-ground hearers who *in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience* are the inverse — the fruit is the keeping.

live_here: Yet they that received it perished, because they kept not the thing that was sown in them.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 2:24 — *through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it.* The seed-war substance behind the fallen-power; the enemy whose power the seventy tread on (Luke 10:19) is the same devil whose envy was the door death came through.

live_here: Nevertheless through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it.

note: Sirach 10:12 — *the beginning of pride is when one departs from Yahuah (God), and his heart is turned away from his Maker.* The heart-turned-away root; Luke 11:46's burden-lading lawyers walk the parallel-Torah-built-on-top the heart-turned-away produces.

live_here: The beginning of pride is when one departs from Yahuah (God), and his heart is turned away from his Maker.

note: Sirach 10:13 — *pride is the beginning of sin, and he that has it shall pour out abomination: and therefore Yahuah (God) brought upon them strange calamities, and overthrew them utterly.* The pride-as-sin's-beginning fruit; Luke 11:43's love-of-the-uppermost-seats is the religious-status pride Sirach diagnosed.

live_here: For pride is the beginning of sin, and he that has it shall pour out abomination: and therefore Yahuah (God) brought upon them strange calamities, and overthrew them utterly.

note: Sirach 21:14 — *the inner parts of a fool are like a broken vessel, and he will hold no knowledge as long as he lives.* The broken-vessel heart that holds no knowledge; Luke 11:52's lawyers took away the key of knowledge because they hold none themselves.

live_here: The inner parts of a fool are like a broken vessel, and he will hold no knowledge as long as he lives.

note: Sirach 21:15 — *as soon as one of no understanding heareth it, it displeaseth him, and he casteth it behind his back.* The man-of-no-understanding casting the wise word behind his back; Luke 11:52's taking-away-the-key is that casting-the-word-behind-the-back, then locking the door against those entering.

live_here: If a skilful man hear a wise word, he will commend it, and add to it: but as soon as one of no understanding heareth it, it displeaseth him, and he casteth it behind his back.

note: Sirach 11:19 — *whereas he says, I have found rest, and now will eat continually of my goods; and yet he knoweth not what time shall come upon him, and that he must leave those things to others, and die.* The Hebrew library names the rich fool word-for-word; Luke 12:19's *take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry* walks the same architecture, and the two things the fool ignores — the unknown hour and the leaving-to-others — are exactly what the verdict names.

note: Sirach 11:18 — *there is that waxeth rich by his wariness and pinching, and this is the portion of his reward.* The hollow-reward of the hoarder; Luke 12:20's *Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be?* lands the reckoning the wisdom-stream set up.

note: Tobit 4:9 — *for you layest up a good treasure for thyself against the day of necessity.* The Hebrew library's *lay up treasure against the day* phrasing inside the charge to give alms; Luke 12:33's *provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not* walks the same architecture.

live_here: For you layest up a good treasure for thyself against the day of necessity.

note: Tobit 4:10 — *because that alms do deliver from death, and suffers not to come into darkness.* The protection-economy of the open hand; Luke 12:33's *a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth* walks the same protection-against-loss architecture.
quote: because that alms do deliver from death, and suffers not to come into darkness.
live_here: Because that alms do deliver from death, and suffers not to come into darkness.

note: Sirach 29:11 — *lay up your treasure according to the commandments of the Most High, and it shall bring you more profit than gold.* The lay-up-treasure-by-the-commandments architecture; Luke 12:33's heaven-bag that faileth not walks the same — the open-handed commandment-keeper's treasure outlasts gold.
quote: lay up your treasure according to the commandments of the Most High, and it shall bring you more profit than gold.
live_here: Lay up your treasure according to the commandments of the Most High, and it shall bring you more profit than gold.

note: Sirach 29:12 — *shut up alms in your storehouses: and it shall deliver you from all affliction.* The Hebrew library's *storehouse* image; Luke 12:33-34's *treasure in the heavens... for where your treasure is, there will your heart be also* walks the same storehouse-of-treasure architecture at the heavenly level.
quote: shut up alms in your storehouses: and it shall deliver you from all affliction.
live_here: Shut up alms in your storehouses: and it shall deliver you from all affliction.

note: Baruch 4:36 — *O Jerusalem, look about you toward the east, and behold the joy that comes to you from Yahuah (God).* The face turned east to behold the gathering-joy; Luke 13:29's come-from-east-and-west walks the same prophetic-gathering register.
quote: O Jerusalem, look about you toward the east, and behold the joy that comes to you from Yahuah (God).
live_here: O Jerusalem, look about you toward the east, and behold the joy that comes to you from Yahuah (God).

note: Baruch 4:37 — *Lo, your sons come, whom you sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west by the word of the Holy One.* The sent-away sons regathered from the quarters; Luke 13:29's come-from-east-and-west names the same scattered children coming home — not strangers added.
quote: Lo, your sons come, whom you sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west by the word of the Holy One.
live_here: Lo, your sons come, whom you sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the glory of Yahuah (God).

note: Baruch 5:5 — *Arise, O Jerusalem... behold your children gathered from the west to the east by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the remembrance of Yahuah (God).* The children led away of their enemies but brought home as children of the kingdom (Baruch 5:6); Luke 13:29's gathering to sit down in the kingdom walks the same substance.
quote: Arise, O Jerusalem... behold your children gathered from the west to the east by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the remembrance of Yahuah (God).
live_here: Arise, O Jerusalem, and stand on high, and look about toward the east, and behold your children gathered from the west to the east by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the remembrance of Yahuah (God).

note: Sirach 36:11 — *gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.* The gathering prayed as a petition for the twelve tribes; Luke 13:29's come-from-the-four-quarters is the answer — the firstborn Yashar'el (Israel) whom Yahuah named (Sirach 36:12) gathered, not a substitute people installed.
quote: gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.
live_here: Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.

note: Sirach 18:13 — *the mercy of Yahuah (God) is upon all flesh: he reproveth, and nurtureth, and teaches and brings again, as a shepherd his flock.* The shepherd-who-brings-again-his-flock; Luke 15:5's *he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing* walks the same bringing-again-the-lost substance.
quote: the mercy of Yahuah (God) is upon all flesh: he reproveth, and nurtureth, and teaches and brings again, as a shepherd his flock.
live_here: The mercy of man is toward his neighbour; but the mercy of Yahuah (God) is upon all flesh: he reproveth, and nurtureth, and teaches and brings again, as a shepherd his flock.

note: 2 Esdras 13:40 — *those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land... whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive.* The lost-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) named; Luke 15:6's *Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost* names the recovery of exactly this lost — the scattered northern house regathered.
quote: those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land... whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive.
live_here: Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.

note: 2 Esdras 2:31 — *remember your children that sleep, for I shall bring them out of the sides of the earth, and shew mercy to them: for I am merciful, says Yahuah (God) Almighty.* The bring-out-the-children-and-show-mercy promise; Luke 15:24's *this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found* walks the same — the scattered child gathered home with mercy.
quote: remember your children that sleep, for I shall bring them out of the sides of the earth, and shew mercy to them: for I am merciful, says Yahuah (God) Almighty.
live_here: Remember your children that sleep, for I shall bring them out of the sides of the earth, and shew mercy to them: for I am merciful, says Yahuah (God) Almighty.

note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 31:5 — *he that loves gold shall not be justified, and he that followeth corruption shall have enough thereof.* The wisdom-stream's gold-love-disqualifies architecture; Luke 16:13's *Ye cannot serve Elohim (God) and mammon* names the same at the forced-choice-of-masters level.
quote: he that loves gold shall not be justified, and he that followeth corruption shall have enough thereof.
live_here: He that loves gold shall not be justified, and he that followeth corruption shall have enough thereof.

note: Sirach 31:6 — *gold has been the ruin of many, and their destruction was present.* The gold-as-ruin diagnostic; the mammon-servant of Luke 16:13 walks toward the same ruin the wisdom-stream named.
quote: gold has been the ruin of many, and their destruction was present.
live_here: Gold has been the ruin of many, and their destruction was present.

note: Sirach 31:7 — *it is a stumblingblock to them that sacrifice to it, and every fool shall be taken with it.* Gold-as-stumblingblock-for-its-devotees; mammon is a competing master at Luke 16:13 because the wisdom-stream had already named gold as the master that takes those who sacrifice to it.
quote: it is a stumblingblock to them that sacrifice to it, and every fool shall be taken with it.
live_here: It is a stumblingblock to them that sacrifice to it, and every fool shall be taken with it.

note: 2 Esdras 7:32 — *the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.* The resurrection-from-the-holding-state register; Luke 16:31's *though one rose from the dead* assumes the chambers give back what was committed to them at the appointed day.
quote: the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.
live_here: And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.

note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 36:11 — *gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.* The wisdom-stream's prayer for the gathering of ALL the tribes; Luke 19:10's seek-and-save-the-lost names the King's enactment of that gathering-mission.
quote: gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.
live_here: Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.

note: Sirach 36:12 — *have mercy upon the people that is called by your name, and upon Yashar'el (Israel), whom you have named your firstborn.* The object of the gathering — the firstborn-people called by the Name; Luke 19:10's lost-that-must-be-sought is this firstborn scattered Lo-Ammi.

live_here: O Yahuah (God), have mercy upon the people that is called by your name, and upon Yashar'el (Israel), whom you have named your firstborn.

note: 2 Esdras 5:23 — *O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, of every wood of the earth, and of all the trees thereof, you have chosen you one only vine.* The Hebrew library names the vineyard as the one-only-vine; Luke 20:9's vineyard let out to husbandmen is this chosen vine of Yashar'el (Israel).

quote: among all the multitudes of people you have gotten you one people: and to this people, whom you lovedst, you gavest a law that is approved of all.
live_here: And among all the multitudes of people you have gotten you one people: and to this people, whom you lovedst, you gavest a law that is approved of all.

quote: of all lands of the whole world you have chosen you one pit: and of all the flowers thereof one lily.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 2:20 — *Let us condemn him with a shameful death: for by his own saying he shall be respected.* The righteous-one-condemned-with-a-shameful-death suffering-half; Luke 24:26's *ought not Messiah (Christ) to have suffered these things* is this shameful-death pattern the slow-of-heart disciples could not read.

live_here: Who has gone over the sea, and found her, and will bring her for pure gold?

note: Baruch 3:37 — *Afterward did he shew himself upon earth, and conversed with men.* The Hebrew library names the descent that answered the wisdom-search; this is the substance of John 3:13's Son of Adam who *came down from heaven* — the wisdom no man could fetch down now standing in flesh.

live_here: This is the book of the commandments of Yahuah (God), and the law that endureth for ever: all they that keep it shall come to life; but such as leave it shall die.

quote: Come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.
live_here: Come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.

note: Sirach 24:21 — *they that eat me shall yet be hungry, and they that drink me shall yet be thirsty.* Wisdom confesses her own limit; John 4:14's *whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst ... a well of water springing up into everlasting life* is the answer the wisdom-stream waited for.

live_here: They that eat me shall yet be hungry, and they that drink me shall yet be thirsty.

note: Sirach 24:23 — *All these things are the book of the covenant of the most high Yahuah (God), even the law which Moses commanded for an heritage to the congregations of Jacob.* Wisdom is the Torah-heritage kept in the covenant line; John 4:22's *salvation is of the Yahudim (Jews)* names the same kept inheritance the living water now flows from to the scattered house.
quote: All these things are the book of the covenant of the most high Yahuah (God), even the law which Moses commanded for an heritage to the congregations of Jacob.
live_here: All these things are the book of the covenant of the most high Yahuah (God), even the law which Moses commanded for an heritage to the congregations of Jacob.

note: 1 Maccabees 4:36 — *let us go up to cleanse and dedicate the sanctuary.* The Hasmonean cleansing of the defiled house; John 2:16's *make not my Father's house an house of merchandise* is the same purging motion, now in the hand of the One whose house it is.
quote: let us go up to cleanse and dedicate the sanctuary.

note: 2 Maccabees 10:2 — *the altars which the heathen had built ... they pulled down.* The rededication tears down the defilement; John 2:15's *he drove them all out of the temple* with the scourge of cords walks the same casting-out of what encroached on the house of prayer.

live_here: But the altars which the heathen had built in the open street, and also the chapels, they pulled down.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 16:20 — *instead of which you feddest your own people with angels' food, and did send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man's delight, and agreeing to every taste.* The manna named angels' food, heaven-sent and labourless; John 6:31's *our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat* cites the same wilderness bread.
quote: instead of which you feddest your own people with angels' food, and did send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man's delight, and agreeing to every taste.
live_here: Instead of which you feddest your own people with angels’ food, and did send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man’s delight, and agreeing to every taste.

live_here: That your children, O Yahuah (God), whom you lovest, might know, that it is not the growing of fruits that nourishes man: but that it is your word, which preserves them that put their trust in you.

note: 2 Esdras 1:19 — *then had I pity upon your mournings, and gave you manna to eat; so you did eat angels' bread.* The wilderness manna named angels' bread given out of the Father's pity; John 6:33's *the bread of Elohim (God) is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world* names the Formed one as the substance the angels' bread prefigured.
quote: then had I pity upon your mournings, and gave you manna to eat; so you did eat angels' bread.
live_here: Then had I pity upon your mournings, and gave you manna to eat; so you did eat angels’ bread.

note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 24:9 (with 24:3, *I came out of the mouth of the Most High*) — *he created me from the beginning before the world, and I shall never fail.* Wisdom's own from-eternity testimony, created before the world and dwelling in Ya'aqov (Jacob) and Yashar'el (Israel); John 8:58's *Before Abraham was, I am* names the same eternity in the Formed Word who came to tabernacle among his own.
quote: I came out of the mouth of the Most High
live_here: He created me from the beginning before the world, and I shall never fail.

note: Tobit 11:11 — *he strake of the gall on his fathers' eyes, saying, Be of good hope, my father.* The eyes-opened-by-the-appointed-means architecture; John 9:7's *go, wash in the pool of Siloam ... and came seeing* walks the same.

live_here: And took hold of his father: and he strake of the gall on his fathers’ eyes, saying, Be of good hope, my father.

note: Tobit 11:13 — *the whiteness pilled away from the corners of his eyes.* The whiteness-peeled-away moment of restored sight; John 9:25's *whereas I was blind, now I see* names the same restored sight, defended against the court.
quote: the whiteness pilled away from the corners of his eyes.

live_here: And among all the multitudes of people you have gotten you one people: and to this people, whom you lovedst, you gavest a law that is approved of all.

live_here: He professeth to have the knowledge of Yahuah (God): and he calls himself the child of Yahuah (God).

live_here: We are esteemed of him as counterfeits: he abstaineth from our ways as from filthiness: he pronounceth the end of the just to be blessed, and makes his boast that Yahuah (God) is his father.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 2:19 — *let us examine him with despitefulness and torture, that we may know his meekness, and prove his patience.* The scourging-and-mockery program the ungodly devise for the righteous one; John 19:1-5 walks the same despitefulness and torture, the meek one brought forth.
quote: let us examine him with despitefulness and torture, that we may know his meekness, and prove his patience.
live_here: Let us examine him with despitefulness and torture, that we may know his meekness, and prove his patience.

live_here: Let us condemn him with a shameful death: for by his own saying he shall be respected.

quote: if the just man be the son of Yahuah (God), he will help him, and deliver him from the hand of his enemies.
live_here: For if the just man be the son of Yahuah (God), he will help him, and deliver him from the hand of his enemies.
