quote: has preserved my body... from the snare of the slanderous tongue, and from the lips that forge lies
live_here: For you are my defender and helper, and has preserved my body from destruction, and from the snare of the slanderous tongue, and from the lips that forge lies, and has been my helper against my adversaries:

note: ★ *delivered me... by the greatness of your name... out of the hands of such as sought after my life* (Sirach 51:3) — delivered by the Name (54:1) from those who *seek after my soul* (54:3).
quote: delivered me... by the greatness of your name... out of the hands of such as sought after my life
live_here: And have delivered me, according to the multitude of your mercies and greatness of your name, from the teeth of them that were ready to devour me, and out of the hands of such as sought after my life, and from the manifold afflictions which I had;

note: ★ *some man is a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of your trouble* (Sirach 6:8) — the fair-weather friend of 55:13: gone in the day of need.
quote: some man is a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of your trouble
live_here: For some man is a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of your trouble.

quote: some friend is a companion at the table, and will not continue in the day of your affliction
live_here: Again, some friend is a companion at the table, and will not continue in the day of your affliction.

note: *If you be brought low, he will be against you, and will hide himself from your face* (Sirach 6:12) — the smooth friend of 55:21: butter-words masking the heart that turns in the fall.
quote: If you be brought low, he will be against you, and will hide himself from your face
live_here: If you be brought low, he will be against you, and will hide himself from your face.

quote: Is it not a grief to death, when a companion and friend is turned to an enemy?
live_here: Is it not a grief to death, when a companion and friend is turned to an enemy?

quote: There is a companion, which rejoices in the prosperity of a friend, but in the time of trouble will be against him

quote: Let us examine him with despitefulness and torture... and prove his patience
live_here: Let us examine him with despitefulness and torture, that we may know his meekness, and prove his patience.

quote: To fear Yahuah (God) is the beginning of wisdom: and it was created with the faithful in the womb
live_here: To fear Yahuah (God) is the beginning of wisdom: and it was created with the faithful in the womb.

quote: If you desire wisdom, keep the commandments, and Yahuah (God) shall give her to you
live_here: If you desire wisdom, keep the commandments, and Yahuah (God) shall give her to you.

live_here: Wisdom is glorious, and never fadeth away: yes, she is easily seen of them that love her, and found of such as seek her.

quote: she goes about seeking such as are worthy of her... and meeteth them in every thought
live_here: For she goes about seeking such as are worthy of her, sheweth herself favourably to them in the ways, and meeteth them in every thought.

quote: Search, and seek, and she shall be made known to you
live_here: Search, and seek, and she shall be made known to you: and when you have got hold of her, let her not go.

live_here: I preferred her before sceptres and thrones, and esteemed riches nothing in comparison of her.

quote: To fear Yahuah (God) is the beginning of wisdom: and it was created with the faithful in the womb
live_here: To fear Yahuah (God) is the beginning of wisdom: and it was created with the faithful in the womb.

quote: If you desire wisdom, keep the commandments, and Yahuah (God) shall give her to you

quote: Give Yahuah (God) his honour with a good eye, and diminish not the firstfruits of yours hands
live_here: Give Yahuah (God) his honour with a good eye, and diminish not the firstfruits of yours hands.

live_here: For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.

live_here: And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.

live_here: I came out of the mouth of the Most High, and covered the earth as a cloud.

quote: He created me from the beginning before the world, and I shall never fail
live_here: He created me from the beginning before the world, and I shall never fail.

quote: To fear Yahuah (God) is the beginning of wisdom: and it was created with the faithful in the womb
live_here: To fear Yahuah (God) is the beginning of wisdom: and it was created with the faithful in the womb.

quote: Come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits
live_here: Come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.

quote: They that eat me shall yet be hungry, and they that drink me shall yet be thirsty
live_here: They that eat me shall yet be hungry, and they that drink me shall yet be thirsty.

quote: He shall take to him his jealousy for complete armour
live_here: He shall take to him his jealousy for complete armour, and make the creature his weapon for the revenge of his enemies.

note: ★★ *He shall put on righteousness as a breastplate, and true judgment instead of an helmet* (Wisdom of Solomon 5:18) — almost word for word with *righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation* (Isaiah 59:17). [extras]
quote: He shall put on righteousness as a breastplate, and true judgment instead of an helmet
live_here: He shall put on righteousness as a breastplate, and true judgment instead of an helmet.

live_here: Wisdom exalteth her children, and layeth hold of them that seek her.

quote: Come to her with your whole heart, and keep her ways with all your power
live_here: Come to her with your whole heart, and keep her ways with all your power.

quote: when you have got hold of her, let her not go
live_here: Search, and seek, and she shall be made known to you: and when you have got hold of her, let her not go.

quote: the light of righteousness has not shined to us, and the sun of righteousness rose not upon us
live_here: Therefore have we erred from the way of truth, and the light of righteousness has not shined to us, and the sun of righteousness rose not upon us.

note: *He that winketh with the eyes works evil: and he that knoweth him will depart from him* (Sirach 27:22) — the near-verbatim of 6:13 *He winketh with his eyes*; the wise, knowing the deceiver, depart from him.
quote: He that winketh with the eyes works evil: and he that knoweth him will depart from him
live_here: He that winketh with the eyes works evil: and he that knoweth him will depart from him.

quote: Three sorts of men my soul hates... a poor man that is proud, a rich man that is a liar, and an old adulterer that doateth
live_here: Three sorts of men my soul hates, and I am greatly offended at their life: a poor man that is proud, a rich man that is a liar, and an old adulterer that doateth.

quote: A man that breaks wedlock, saying thus in his heart, Who seeth me? ... the walls cover me
live_here: A man that breaks wedlock, saying thus in his heart, Who seeth me? I am compassed about with darkness, the walls cover me, and no body seeth me; what need I to fear? the Most High will not remember my sins:

quote: the eyes of Yahuah are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, beholding all the ways of men

note: *a fornicator in the body of his flesh will never cease till he has kindled a fire* (Sirach 23:16) — the same coal of 6:27-28; the adulterer carries the fire that consumes him.

live_here: Two sorts of men multiply sin, and the third will bring wrath: a hot mind is as a burning fire, it will never be quenched till it be consumed: a fornicator in the body of his flesh will never cease till he has kindled a fire.

note: *When one prayeth, and another curses, whose voice will Yahuah (God) hear?* (Sirach 34:24) — the restored witness asks the very question 28:9 answers.
quote: When one prayeth, and another curses, whose voice will Yahuah (God) hear?
live_here: When one prayeth, and another curses, whose voice will Yahuah (God) hear?

quote: if he curse you in the bitterness of his soul, his prayer shall be heard of him that made him

quote: O Yahuah (God) of my fathers... who have made all things with your word
live_here: O Yahuah (God) of my fathers, and Yahuah (God) of mercy, who have made all things with your word,

quote: A good wife is a good portion, which shall be given in the portion of them that fear Yahuah (God)

live_here: Turn away your eye from a beautiful woman, and look not upon another’s beauty; for many have been deceived by the beauty of a woman; for herewith love is kindled as a fire.

note: *A man that breaks wedlock, saying thus in his heart, Who seeth me?* (Sirach 23:18) — the very self-deceiving thought 5:21 refutes; the darkness he trusts is no cover.
quote: A man that breaks wedlock, saying thus in his heart, Who seeth me?
live_here: A man that breaks wedlock, saying thus in his heart, Who seeth me? I am compassed about with darkness, the walls cover me, and no body seeth me; what need I to fear? the Most High will not remember my sins:

note: *the eyes of Yahuah (God) are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, beholding all the ways of men* (Sirach 23:19) — 5:21 made vivid; the eye that beholds all the ways lays the strange-woman's path bare.
quote: the eyes of Yahuah (God) are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, beholding all the ways of men
live_here: Such a man only fears the eyes of men, and knoweth not that the eyes of Yahuah (God) are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, beholding all the ways of men, and considering the most secret parts.

note: *Meet not with an harlot, lest you fall into her snares* (Sirach 9:3) — the plain counsel the youth of 7:7 did not heed.
quote: Meet not with an harlot, lest you fall into her snares
live_here: Meet not with an harlot, lest you fall into her snares.

note: *he that cleaveth to harlots will become impudent* (Sirach 19:2) — even men of understanding fall away; how much more the young man void of understanding (7:22).
quote: he that cleaveth to harlots will become impudent
live_here: Wine and women will make men of understanding to fall away: and he that cleaveth to harlots will become impudent.

note: *the tongue of man is his fall* (Sirach 5:13) — the restored witness weighs the wicked mouth of 10:11; the violent tongue is the man's own undoing.
quote: the tongue of man is his fall
live_here: Honour and shame is in talk: and the tongue of man is his fall.

note: *the stroke of the tongue breaks the bones* (Sirach 28:17) — the violence that covers the wicked mouth (10:11) strikes deeper than the lash.
quote: the stroke of the tongue breaks the bones
live_here: The stroke of the whip makes marks in the flesh: but the stroke of the tongue breaks the bones.

note: *not so many as have fallen by the tongue* (Sirach 28:18) — the wicked mouth of 10:11 slays more than the sword; against it stands the well-of-life mouth that feeds many (10:21).
quote: not so many as have fallen by the tongue
live_here: Many have fallen by the edge of the sword: but not so many as have fallen by the tongue.

note: *The fear of Yahuah (God) makes a merry heart, and gives joy, and gladness, and a long life* (Sirach 1:12) — the restored witness binds the fear to long life exactly as 10:27.
quote: The fear of Yahuah (God) makes a merry heart, and gives joy, and gladness, and a long life
live_here: The fear of Yahuah (God) makes a merry heart, and gives joy, and gladness, and a long life.

note: *The root of wisdom is to fear Yahuah (God), and the branches thereof are long life* (Sirach 1:20) — the same tree as 10:27: fear at the root, long life on the branches.
quote: The root of wisdom is to fear Yahuah (God), and the branches thereof are long life
live_here: The root of wisdom is to fear Yahuah (God), and the branches thereof are long life.

note: *Pride is hateful before Yahuah (God) and man* (Sirach 10:7) — what is hateful before Yahuah cannot but end in the shame 11:2 foretells.
quote: Pride is hateful before Yahuah (God) and man
live_here: Pride is hateful before Yahuah (God) and man: and by both does one commit iniquity.

note: *The beginning of pride is when one departs from Yahuah (God)* (Sirach 10:12) — the root of the pride 11:2 names; the lowly keep near their Maker.
quote: The beginning of pride is when one departs from Yahuah (God)
live_here: The beginning of pride is when one departs from Yahuah (God), and his heart is turned away from his Maker.

note: *pride is the beginning of sin... and overthrew them utterly* (Sirach 10:13) — the shame of 11:2 drawn to its end, the overthrow.
quote: pride is the beginning of sin... and overthrew them utterly
live_here: For pride is the beginning of sin, and he that has it shall pour out abomination: and therefore Yahuah (God) brought upon them strange calamities, and overthrew them utterly.

note: *stretch yours hand to the poor, that your blessing may be perfected* (Sirach 7:32) — the open hand of 11:25 draws back a perfected blessing.
quote: stretch yours hand to the poor, that your blessing may be perfected
live_here: And stretch yours hand to the poor, that your blessing may be perfected.

note: *give with a cheerful eye* (Sirach 35:10) — the liberal soul of 11:25 gives gladly; the withholder tends to poverty.
quote: give with a cheerful eye
live_here: Give to the Most High according as he has enriched you; and as you have gotten, give with a cheerful eye.

note: *the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them* (Wisdom of Solomon 3:1) — the recompense of 11:31 is safe-keeping in Yahuah's hand.
quote: the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them
live_here: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.

note: *the righteous live for evermore; their reward also is with Yahuah (God)* (Wisdom of Solomon 5:15) — the recompense of 11:31 made everlasting.
quote: the righteous live for evermore; their reward also is with Yahuah (God)
live_here: But the righteous live for evermore; their reward also is with Yahuah (God), and the care of them is with the Most High.

note: *Honour and shame is in talk: and the tongue of man is his fall* (Sirach 5:13) — the restored witness weighs the tongue as 12:17 does; righteousness or deceit hangs on what it speaks.
quote: Honour and shame is in talk: and the tongue of man is his fall
live_here: Honour and shame is in talk: and the tongue of man is his fall.

note: *an evil condemnation upon the double tongue* (Sirach 5:14) — the *lying tongue but for a moment* (12:19) earns the restored witness's condemnation of the double tongue; only the single, truthful lip endures.
quote: an evil condemnation upon the double tongue
live_here: Be not called a whisperer, and lie not in wait with your tongue: for a foul shame is upon the thief, and an evil condemnation upon the double tongue.

note: *the stroke of the tongue breaks the bones* (Sirach 28:17) — *that speaketh like the piercings of a sword* (12:18); the wounding tongue does deeper harm than the whip, while the wise tongue is health.
quote: the stroke of the tongue breaks the bones
live_here: The stroke of the whip makes marks in the flesh: but the stroke of the tongue breaks the bones.

note: *Curse the whisperer and doubletongued: for such have destroyed many that were at peace* (Sirach 28:13) — the lying lips that are *abomination to Yahuah* (12:22); the deceitful tongue wrecks the peace of many.
quote: Curse the whisperer and doubletongued: for such have destroyed many that were at peace
live_here: Curse the whisperer and doubletongued: for such have destroyed many that were at peace.

note: ★ *he must leave those things to others, and die* (Sirach 11:19) — the man who rests in his goods (62:10) leaves them all and dies: riches that cannot be kept.
quote: he must leave those things to others, and die
live_here: Whereas he says, I have found rest, and now will eat continually of my goods; and yet he knoweth not what time shall come upon him, and that he must leave those things to others, and die.

note: ★ *As his mercy is great, so is his correction also: he judges a man according to his works* (Sirach 16:12) — the restored wisdom binds 62:12's mercy AND recompense: mercy and correction both great.
quote: As his mercy is great, so is his correction also: he judges a man according to his works
live_here: As his mercy is great, so is his correction also: he judges a man according to his works

note: ★ *every man shall find according to his works* (Sirach 16:14) — what 62:12 says Yahuah renders, the wisdom says every man shall find: the same Torah-consistent recompense.
quote: every man shall find according to his works
live_here: Make way for every work of mercy: for every man shall find according to his works.

note: *They that eat me shall yet be hungry, and they that drink me shall yet be thirsty* (Sirach 24:21) — the contrast to 63:1: even Wisdom's water leaves thirst; only the living Elohim satisfies.
quote: They that eat me shall yet be hungry, and they that drink me shall yet be thirsty
live_here: They that eat me shall yet be hungry, and they that drink me shall yet be thirsty.

note: ★ *the stroke of the tongue breaks the bones* (Sirach 28:17) — the restored wisdom weighs the wound of 64:3: the tongue cuts deeper than the whip.
quote: the stroke of the tongue breaks the bones
live_here: The stroke of the whip makes marks in the flesh: but the stroke of the tongue breaks the bones.

note: ★ *not so many as have fallen by the tongue* (Sirach 28:18) — the tongue whetted like a sword (64:3) is the deadlier blade: more fall by it than by the sword.
quote: not so many as have fallen by the tongue
live_here: Many have fallen by the edge of the sword: but not so many as have fallen by the tongue.

note: ★ *Many nations shall come from far to the name of Yahuah (God) with gifts in their hands* (Tobit 13:11) — the restored Tobit sings the same ingathering: the nations stream to the Name (65:2).
quote: Many nations shall come from far to the name of Yahuah (God) with gifts in their hands
live_here: Many nations shall come from far to the name of Yahuah (God) with gifts in their hands, even gifts to the King of heaven; all generations shall praise you with great joy.

note: ★ *By his commandment he makes the snow to fall... Through this the treasures are opened* (Sirach 43:13-14) — the restored wisdom watches the same hand over the seasons as 65:11: Yahuah's ordering of cloud and snow unto the harvest.
quote: By his commandment he makes the snow to fall... Through this the treasures are opened
live_here: By his commandment he makes the snow to fall aplace, and sends swiftly the lightnings of his judgment.

note: ★ *For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity* (Sirach 2:5) — the restored wisdom's assay of 66:10: the furnace that makes men acceptable.
quote: For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity
live_here: For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.

note: ★ *Yahuah (God) proved them, and found them worthy for himself* (Wisdom 3:5) — *thou hast proved us* (66:10): the proving ends in the worthy ones found for Himself.
quote: Yahuah (God) proved them, and found them worthy for himself
live_here: And having been a little chastised, they shall be greatly rewarded: for Yahuah (God) proved them, and found them worthy for himself.

note: ★ *As gold in the furnace has he tried them, and received them as a burnt offering* (Wisdom 3:6) — the fire of 66:12 refines the people into an offering received, joining 66:13 *I will go into thy house with burnt offerings.*
quote: As gold in the furnace has he tried them, and received them as a burnt offering
live_here: As gold in the furnace has he tried them, and received them as a burnt offering.

note: ★ *the King of the world shall raise us up, who have died for his laws, to everlasting life* (2 Maccabees 7:9) — the martyr's resurrection hope, the answer of faith to death (Isaiah 26:19).
quote: the King of the world shall raise us up, who have died for his laws, to everlasting life
live_here: And when he was at the last gasp, he said, You like a fury takest us out of this present life, but the King of the world shall raise us up, who have died for his laws, to everlasting life.

note: *He that loves his son causeth him oft to feel the rod* (Sirach 30:1) — the restored witness states 13:24 almost word for word; love and the rod bound together.
quote: He that loves his son causeth him oft to feel the rod
live_here: He that loves his son causeth him oft to feel the rod, that he may have joy of him in the end.

quote: He that chastiseth his son shall have joy in him
live_here: He that chastiseth his son shall have joy in him, and shall rejoice of him among his acquaintance.

note: *There is that waxeth rich by his wariness and pinching* (Sirach 11:18) — the self-made rich of 13:7 in the restored witness; his hoard's end follows.
quote: There is that waxeth rich by his wariness and pinching
live_here: There is that waxeth rich by his wariness and pinching, and this is the portion of his reward:

quote: he must leave those things to others, and die
live_here: Whereas he says, I have found rest, and now will eat continually of my goods; and yet he knoweth not what time shall come upon him, and that he must leave those things to others, and die.

note: *To fear Yahuah (God) is the beginning of wisdom: and it was created with the faithful in the womb* (Sirach 1:14) — the restored witness sings the confidence of 14:26; no late acquisition, but from the womb.
quote: To fear Yahuah (God) is the beginning of wisdom: and it was created with the faithful in the womb
live_here: To fear Yahuah (God) is the beginning of wisdom: and it was created with the faithful in the womb.

live_here: The root of wisdom is to fear Yahuah (God), and the branches thereof are long life.

quote: The fear of Yahuah (God) makes a merry heart, and gives joy, and gladness, and a long life
live_here: The fear of Yahuah (God) makes a merry heart, and gives joy, and gladness, and a long life.

live_here: As the clay is in the potter’s hand, to fashion it at his pleasure: so man is in the hand of him that made him, to render to them as liketh him best.

note: *pray to the Most High, that he will direct your way in truth* (Sirach 37:15) — the only wise response to 16:1: the heart must be prepared by the One from whom the answer comes.

live_here: And above all this pray to the Most High, that he will direct your way in truth.

live_here: To depart from wickedness is a thing pleasing to Yahuah (God); and to forsake unrighteousness is a propitiation.

live_here: Pride is hateful before Yahuah (God) and man: and by both does one commit iniquity.

quote: The beginning of pride is when one departs from Yahuah (God)
live_here: The beginning of pride is when one departs from Yahuah (God), and his heart is turned away from his Maker.

live_here: For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.

live_here: My son, defraud not the poor of his living, and make not the needy eyes to wait long.

quote: A faithfull friend is a strong defence... a treasure
live_here: A faithfull friend is a strong defence: and he that has found such an one has found a treasure.

quote: A faithful friend is the medicine of life; and they that fear Yahuah (God) shall find him
live_here: A faithful friend is the medicine of life; and they that fear Yahuah (God) shall find him.

quote: Many nations shall come from far to the name of Yahuah (God) with gifts in their hands... all generations shall praise you

quote: will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us
live_here: And he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us.

note: ★ *did ever any trust in Yahuah (God), and was confounded?* (Sirach 2:10) — the plea of 71:1 tested against all the ages: none who trusted were ever put to shame.
quote: did ever any trust in Yahuah (God), and was confounded?
live_here: Look at the generations of old, and see; did ever any trust in Yahuah (God), and was confounded? or did any abide in his fear, and was forsaken? or whom did he ever despise, that called upon him?

note: ★ *the fear of Yahuah (God) is their glory* (Sirach 25:6) — the restored wisdom crowns the grayhead of 71:18: long experience given to teach the generation.
quote: the fear of Yahuah (God) is their glory
live_here: Much experience is the crown of old men, and the fear of Yahuah (God) is their glory.

note: ★ *the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God)... in the time of their visitation they shall shine* (Wisdom 3:1,7) — the end seen in the sanctuary (73:17): the righteous held safe, only seeming to die.
quote: the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God)... in the time of their visitation they shall shine
live_here: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.

live_here: But the ungodly shall be punished according to their own imaginations, which have neglected the righteous, and forsaken Yahuah (God).

quote: What has pride profited us?... passed away like a shadow
live_here: What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us?

live_here: And having been a little chastised, they shall be greatly rewarded: for Yahuah (God) proved them, and found them worthy for himself.

quote: As gold in the furnace has he tried them, and received them as a burnt offering
live_here: As gold in the furnace has he tried them, and received them as a burnt offering.

quote: For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity
live_here: For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.

live_here: The stroke of the whip makes marks in the flesh: but the stroke of the tongue breaks the bones.

quote: not so many as have fallen by the tongue
live_here: Many have fallen by the edge of the sword: but not so many as have fallen by the tongue.

note: *A faithful friend is a strong defence... has found a treasure* (Sirach 6:14) — the restored witness echoes 18:24; the true friend is a fortress and a treasure found.
quote: A faithful friend is a strong defence... has found a treasure
live_here: A faithfull friend is a strong defence: and he that has found such an one has found a treasure.

note: *A faithful friend is the medicine of life; and they that fear Yahuah (God) shall find him* (Sirach 6:16) — the friend closer than a brother (18:24) is a balm, a gift bound to the fear of Yahuah.
quote: A faithful friend is the medicine of life; and they that fear Yahuah (God) shall find him
live_here: A faithful friend is the medicine of life; and they that fear Yahuah (God) shall find him.

quote: Forsake not an old friend; for the new is not comparable to him
live_here: Forsake not an old friend; for the new is not comparable to him: a new friend is as new wine; when it is old, you shall drink it with pleasure.

note: *Blessed is the man that has a virtuous wife* (Sirach 26:1) — the restored witness echoes 18:22; the good wife lengthens a man's very days.
quote: Blessed is the man that has a virtuous wife
live_here: Blessed is the man that has a virtuous wife, for the number of his days shall be double.

note: *A good wife is a good portion, which shall be given in the portion of them that fear Yahuah (God)* (Sirach 26:3) — the favour-of-Yahuah of 18:22 named a portion given to them that fear Him.
quote: A good wife is a good portion, which shall be given in the portion of them that fear Yahuah (God)
live_here: A good wife is a good portion, which shall be given in the portion of them that fear Yahuah (God).

quote: He that getteth a wife begins a possession, a help like to himself, and a pillar of rest
live_here: He that getteth a wife begins a possession, a help like to himself, and a pillar of rest.

note: *defraud not the poor of his living, and make not the needy eyes to wait long* (Sirach 4:1) — to withhold from the poor is to default on a loan owed to Yahuah.
quote: defraud not the poor of his living, and make not the needy eyes to wait long

quote: she drowned their enemies, and cast them up out of the bottom of the deep

live_here: Instead of which you feddest your own people with angels’ food, and did send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man’s delight, and agreeing to every taste.

note: *it is your word, which preserves them that put their trust in you* (Wisdom of Solomon 16:26) — the witness draws from the manna the lesson of *that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law* (16:4): man is sustained by the word.
quote: it is your word, which preserves them that put their trust in you
live_here: That your children, O Yahuah (God), whom you lovest, might know, that it is not the growing of fruits that nourishes man: but that it is your word, which preserves them that put their trust in you.

note: *water was given them out of the flinty rock, and their thirst was quenched out of the hard stone* (Wisdom of Solomon 11:4) — the restored witness keeps the mercy of 17:6: the hard stone yielding water, answering *Is Yahuah among us, or not?*
quote: water was given them out of the flinty rock, and their thirst was quenched out of the hard stone
live_here: When they were thirsty, they called upon you, and water was given them out of the flinty rock, and their thirst was quenched out of the hard stone.

quote: Was not Abraham found faithful... it was imputed to him for righteousness?
live_here: Was not Abraham found faithful in temptation, and it was imputed to him for righteousness?

live_here: Phinees our father in being zealous and fervent obtained the covenant of an everlasting priesthood.

quote: Phinees... had zeal in the fear of Yahuah, and stood up with good courage of heart... made reconciliation for Yashar'el

quote: a burning pillar of fire, both to be a guide of the unknown journey, and an harmless sun

quote: Accustom not your mouth to swearing; neither use thyself to the naming of the Holy One
live_here: Accustom not your mouth to swearing; neither use thyself to the naming of the Holy One.

live_here: All these things are the book of the covenant of the most high Yahuah (God), even the law which Moses commanded for an heritage to the congregations of Jacob.

note: ★ *the book of the commandments of Yahuah (God), and the law that endureth for ever* (Baruch 4:1) — the restored witness names the settled word the LAW THAT ENDURETH FOR EVER (119:89).
quote: the book of the commandments of Yahuah (God), and the law that endureth for ever
live_here: This is the book of the commandments of Yahuah (God), and the law that endureth for ever: all they that keep it shall come to life; but such as leave it shall die.

note: ★ *the ungodly shall be punished according to their own imaginations, which have neglected the righteous* (Wisdom of Solomon 3:10) — the deed of the wicked returns on his own head; *the reward of his hands* (Isaiah 3:11).
quote: the ungodly shall be punished according to their own imaginations, which have neglected the righteous
live_here: But the ungodly shall be punished according to their own imaginations, which have neglected the righteous, and forsaken Yahuah (God).

note: ★ *water was given them out of the flinty rock... out of the hard stone* (Wisdom of Solomon 11:4) — the restored wisdom remembers the rock-fountain of 114:8.
quote: water was given them out of the flinty rock... out of the hard stone
live_here: When they were thirsty, they called upon you, and water was given them out of the flinty rock, and their thirst was quenched out of the hard stone.

note: *a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning* (Wisdom of Solomon 9:8) — a clean pattern-parallel to *after the pattern of the tabernacle* (25:9); the heavenly prepared from the beginning.
quote: a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning
live_here: You have commanded me to build a temple upon your holy mount, and an altar in the city in which you dwellest, a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning.

quote: the brightness of the everlasting light... the image of his goodness
live_here: For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of Yahuah (God), and the image of his goodness.

note: *A merchant shall hardly keep himself from doing wrong; and an huckster shall not be freed from sin* (Sirach 26:29) — the wisdom-witness on the very snare in which Tyre's *merchants are princes* (Isaiah 23:8) grew proud.
quote: A merchant shall hardly keep himself from doing wrong; and an huckster shall not be freed from sin
live_here: A merchant shall hardly keep himself from doing wrong; and an huckster shall not be freed from sin.

quote: In his time the sun went backward, and he lengthened the king's life

live_here: Curse the whisperer and doubletongued: for such have destroyed many that were at peace.

quote: A backbiting tongue has... driven them from nation to nation
live_here: A backbiting tongue has disquieted many, and driven them from nation to nation: strong cities has it pulled down, and overthrown the houses of great men.

quote: O blessed are they which love thee, for they shall rejoice in thy peace... and shall be glad for ever

quote: Whoso fears Yahuah, it shall go well with him at the last
live_here: Whoso fears Yahuah (God), it shall go well with him at the last, and he shall find favour in the day of his death.

note: Ecclesiasticus 26:3 — *A good wife... given in the portion of them that fear Yahuah*: the fruitful vine bound to the very fear the whole psalm turns on (26:1, days doubled).
quote: A good wife... given in the portion of them that fear Yahuah
live_here: A good wife is a good portion, which shall be given in the portion of them that fear Yahuah (God).

note: 2 Esdras 8:36 — *if you be merciful to them which have not the confidence of good works*: the standing rests on mercy, not on a store of works.
quote: if you be merciful to them which have not the confidence of good works
live_here: For in this, O Yahuah (God), your righteousness and your goodness shall be declared, if you be merciful to them which have not the confidence of good works.

note: Ecclesiasticus 2:7 — *You that fear Yahuah (God), wait for his mercy*: binds the waiting to the fear of v.4 — one posture kept from turning aside.
quote: You that fear Yahuah (God), wait for his mercy
live_here: You that fear Yahuah (God), wait for his mercy; and go not aside, lest you fall.

note: Ecclesiasticus 2:11 — *full of compassion and mercy... forgiveth sins, and saves in time of affliction*: Ben Sira names the mercy and plenteous redemption of Psalm 130:7 in the Sinai Name's own words.
quote: full of compassion and mercy... forgiveth sins, and saves in time of affliction
live_here: For Yahuah (God) is full of compassion and mercy, longsuffering, and very pitiful, and forgiveth sins, and saves in time of affliction.

note: *the unity of brothers* (Ecclesiasticus 25:1) — named beautiful before Yahuah (God).
quote: the unity of brothers
live_here: In three things I was beautified, and stood up beautiful both before Yahuah (God) and men: the unity of brothers, the love of neighbours, a man and a wife that agree together.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 15:15 — idols *neither have the use of eyes to see, nor noses to draw breath, nor ears to hear*, the psalm's very catalogue.

live_here: For they counted all the idols of the heathen to be gods: which neither have the use of eyes to see, nor noses to draw breath, nor ears to hear, nor fingers of hands to handle; and as for their feet, they are slow to go.

quote: man made them ... but no man can make a god like to himself
live_here: For man made them, and he that borrowed his own spirit fashioned them: but no man can make a god like to himself.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 16:9 — *the bitings of grasshoppers and flies killed* the enemy; measured recompense on the oppressor while Yahuah's sons are spared.

live_here: For them the bitings of grasshoppers and flies killed, neither was there found any remedy for their life: for they were worthy to be punished by such.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 16:16 — the hail/fire retold as a measured wonder scourging the ungodly that denied to know Yahuah.

quote: fire burning in the hail
live_here: But snow and ice endured the fire, and melted not, that they might know that fire burning in the hail, and sparkling in the rain, did destroy the fruits of the enemies.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 17:20 — *the whole world shined with clear light*; the restored library retells the plague-distinction of Yashar'el (Israel).

live_here: For the whole world shined with clear light, and none were hindered in their labour:

quote: your saints had a very great light
live_here: Nevertheless your saints had a very great light, whose voice they hearing, and not seeing their shape, because they also had not suffered the same things, they counted them happy.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 18:4 — *the uncorrupt light of the law was to be given to the world*; the plague read as covenant justice on those who imprisoned Yahuah's sons.
quote: the uncorrupt light of the law was to be given to the world
live_here: For they were worthy to be deprived of light and imprisoned in darkness, who had kept your sons shut up, by whom the uncorrupt light of the law was to be given to the world.

note: *you tookest away the multitude of their children* (Wisdom of Solomon 18:5) — Wisdom reads the firstborn-cry as just recompense for Egypt's slaughter of the Hebrew babes.
quote: you tookest away the multitude of their children
live_here: And when they had determined to slay the babes of the saints, one child being cast forth, and saved, to reprove them, you tookest away the multitude of their children, and destroyedst them altogether in a mighty water.

note: *upon the destruction of the firstborn, they acknowledged this people to be the sons of Yahuah (God)* (Wisdom of Solomon 18:13) — Egypt itself confesses the difference Yahuah put.
quote: upon the destruction of the firstborn, they acknowledged this people to be the sons of Yahuah (God)
live_here: For whereas they would not believe any thing by reason of the enchantments; upon the destruction of the firstborn, they acknowledged this people to be the sons of Yahuah (God).

note: Baruch 1:4 (extras) — *all them that dwelt at Babylon by the river Sud*: the scribe of the exile writes from inside the Psalm's very scene, by the river in Babylon.

live_here: And in the hearing of the nobles, and of the king’s sons, and in the hearing of the elders, and of all the people, from the lowest to the highest, even of all them that dwelt at Babylon by the river Sud.

note: Baruch 4:33 (extras) — *as she rejoiced at your ruin... so shall she be grieved for her own desolation*: the talionic reversal named from inside the exile.
quote: as she rejoiced at your ruin... so shall she be grieved for her own desolation
live_here: For as she rejoiced at your ruin, and was glad of your fall: so shall she be grieved for her own desolation.

note: Sirach 28:18 — Ben Sira weighs the tongue heavier than the sword: *not so many... fallen by the tongue*. [extras]
quote: not so many... fallen by the tongue
live_here: Many have fallen by the edge of the sword: but not so many as have fallen by the tongue.

note: *Give alms of your substance... neither turn your face from any poor, and the face of Yahuah (God) shall not be turned away from you* (Tobit 4:7) — the exile-righteous Tobit lives the Mishpat of *Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him* (Exodus 22:21) among the nations.

live_here: Give alms of your substance; and when you give alms, let not your eye be envious, neither turn your face from any poor, and the face of Yahuah (God) shall not be turned away from you.

note: ★ *To whom has he given power to declare his works? and who shall find out his noble acts?* (Sirach 18:4) — the restored witness presses the unsearchable greatness of 145:3.
quote: To whom has he given power to declare his works? and who shall find out his noble acts?
live_here: To whom has he given power to declare his works? and who shall find out his noble acts?

quote: Who shall number the strength of his majesty? and who shall also tell out his mercies?
live_here: Who shall number the strength of his majesty? and who shall also tell out his mercies?

note: ★★ *the mercy of Yahuah (God) is upon all flesh: he reproveth, and nurtureth, and teaches and brings again, as a shepherd his flock* (Sirach 18:13) — the restored witness says the widening of 145:9 outright: mercy upon all flesh.
quote: the mercy of Yahuah (God) is upon all flesh: he reproveth, and nurtureth, and teaches and brings again, as a shepherd his flock
live_here: The mercy of man is toward his neighbour; but the mercy of Yahuah (God) is upon all flesh: he reproveth, and nurtureth, and teaches and brings again, as a shepherd his flock.

live_here: An everlasting covenant he made with him and gave him the priesthood among the people; he beautified him with comely ornaments, and clothed him with a robe of glory.

note: ★ *many golden bells round about, that as he went there might be a sound... for a memorial to the children of his people* (Sirach 45:9) — the bells and pomegranates of Exodus 28:33-35, heard before Yahuah on the people's behalf.
quote: many golden bells round about, that as he went there might be a sound... for a memorial to the children of his people
live_here: And he compassed him with pomegranates, and with many golden bells round about, that as he went there might be a sound, and a noise made that might be heard in the temple, for a memorial to the children of his people;

note: ★ *a breastplate of judgment, and with Urim and Thummim* (Sirach 45:10) — Exodus 28:30 named verbatim in the catalogue of Aaron's glory.
quote: a breastplate of judgment, and with Urim and Thummim
live_here: With an holy garment, with gold, and blue silk, and purple, the work of the embroiderer, with a breastplate of judgment, and with Urim and Thummim;

note: ★ *a crown of gold upon the mitre, in which was engraved Holiness* (Sirach 45:12) — the plate HOLINESS TO YAHUAH on the mitre (Exodus 28:36) as the chief glory of the vesture.
quote: a crown of gold upon the mitre, in which was engraved Holiness
live_here: He set a crown of gold upon the mitre, in which was engraved Holiness, an ornament of honour, a costly work, the desires of the eyes, goodly and beautiful.

note: ★ *in the long garment was the whole world, and in the four rows of the stones was the glory of the fathers graven* (Wisdom 18:24) — the four-row breastplate (Exodus 28:17) bearing the patriarchs; the priest vested as cosmos and covenant fathers in one.
quote: in the long garment was the whole world, and in the four rows of the stones was the glory of the fathers graven
live_here: For in the long garment was the whole world, and in the four rows of the stones was the glory of the fathers graven, and your Majesty upon the diadem of his head.

note: Ecclesiasticus 45:15 — *anointed him with holy oil... an everlasting covenant*: Ben Sira reads the anointing of Exodus 29:7 as a standing, everlasting ordinance.

live_here: Moses consecrated him, and anointed him with holy oil: this was appointed to him by an everlasting covenant, and to his seed, so long as the heavens should remain, that they should minister to him, and execute the office of the priesthood, and bless the people in his name.

note: Ecclesiasticus 45:7 — *an everlasting covenant... the priesthood among the people*: the office of Exodus 29:9 honoured as Aaron's everlasting covenant, fulfilled not cancelled by the better priesthood.
quote: an everlasting covenant... the priesthood among the people
live_here: An everlasting covenant he made with him and gave him the priesthood among the people; he beautified him with comely ornaments, and clothed him with a robe of glory.

note: Ecclesiasticus 45:14 — *their sacrifices shall be wholly consumed every day twice continually*: Ben Sira confirms the twice-daily tamid of Exodus 29:38.
quote: their sacrifices shall be wholly consumed every day twice continually
live_here: Their sacrifices shall be wholly consumed every day twice continually.

live_here: Moses consecrated him, and anointed him with holy oil: this was appointed to him by an everlasting covenant, and to his seed, so long as the heavens should remain, that they should minister to him, and execute the office of the priesthood, and bless the people in his name.

note: *to offer... incense, and a sweet savour, for a memorial, to make reconciliation* (Sirach 45:16) — Aaron chosen to offer the incense of Exodus 30:7-8.

note: *a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning* (Wisdom of Solomon 9:8) — the curtains of Exodus 26:1 copy a dwelling older than the world.
quote: a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning
live_here: You have commanded me to build a temple upon your holy mount, and an altar in the city in which you dwellest, a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning.

note: *Their sacrifices shall be wholly consumed every day twice continually* (Ecclesiasticus 45:14) — the unbroken daily offering.
quote: Their sacrifices shall be wholly consumed every day twice continually
live_here: Their sacrifices shall be wholly consumed every day twice continually.

note: *he poured out at the foot of the altar a sweetsmelling savour* (Ecclesiasticus 50:15) — the high priest at the altar of atonement.
quote: he poured out at the foot of the altar a sweetsmelling savour
live_here: He stretched out his hand to the cup, and poured of the blood of the grape, he poured out at the foot of the altar a sweetsmelling savour to the most high King of all.

note: *As you have gotten, give with a cheerful eye* (Ecclesiasticus 35:10) — the fathers' wisdom guards the same willing, cheerful gift.
quote: As you have gotten, give with a cheerful eye
live_here: Give to the Most High according as he has enriched you; and as you have gotten, give with a cheerful eye.

note: *Give to the Most High according as he has enriched you... with a cheerful eye* (Sirach 35:9-10) — the fathers' wisdom names the glad overflow of 36:5.
quote: Give to the Most High according as he has enriched you... with a cheerful eye
live_here: In all your gifts shew a cheerful countenance, and dedicate your tithes with gladness.

note: *A resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning* (Wisdom of Solomon 9:8) — the pattern is older than the mount.
quote: A resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning
live_here: You have commanded me to build a temple upon your holy mount, and an altar in the city in which you dwellest, a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning.

note: *into the temple they brought the candlestick, and the altar of... incense, and the table* (1 Maccabees 4:49) — the made furniture restored at the rededication.
quote: into the temple they brought the candlestick, and the altar of... incense, and the table
live_here: They made also new holy vessels, and into the temple they brought the candlestick, and the altar of burnt offerings, and of incense, and the table.

note: *they burned incense, and the lamps... they lighted* (1 Maccabees 4:50) — the appointed worship taken up again, never abolished.

note: *has given it to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved* (Baruch 3:36) — the one Elohim who gave the Torah-wisdom to His people alone.
quote: has given it to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved
live_here: He has found out all the way of knowledge, and has given it to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved.

note: Ecclesiasticus 37:4 — *a companion... in the time of trouble will be against him*: Sirach's portrait of the fair-weather friend, the very friend Job indicts (Job 6:14-15).
quote: a companion... in the time of trouble will be against him
live_here: There is a companion, which rejoices in the prosperity of a friend, but in the time of trouble will be against him.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 2:4-5 (extras) — *our life shall pass away as the trace of a cloud... a very shadow that passeth away; and after our end there is no returning*: Job's very image (Job 7:9), but in the mouth of the ungodly who hold it WITHOUT hope and turn from it to oppress the righteous. The same shadow; the heart makes the difference.
quote: our life shall pass away as the trace of a cloud... a very shadow that passeth away; and after our end there is no returning
live_here: And our name shall be forgotten in time, and no man shall have our works in remembrance, and our life shall pass away as the trace of a cloud, and shall be dispersed as a mist, that is driven away with the beams of the sun, and overcome with the heat thereof.

note: Ecclesiasticus 18:8-10 (extras) — *what is man, and to which serveth he?... so are a thousand years to the days of eternity*: the wisdom library carries Job's question and frames it with the measure that makes it — man's little span against eternity, a drop to the sea.
quote: what is man, and to which serveth he?... so are a thousand years to the days of eternity
live_here: What is man, and to which serveth he? what is his good, and what is his evil?

note: *Miss not the discourse of the elders: for they also learned of their fathers* (Sirach 8:9) — the wisdom tradition honors the handed-down counsel Bildad appeals to in *the search of their fathers* (Job 8:8); yet Job shows the fathers' formula does not fit every righteous sufferer.
quote: Miss not the discourse of the elders: for they also learned of their fathers
live_here: Miss not the discourse of the elders: for they also learned of their fathers, and of them you shall learn understanding, and to give answer as need requires.

note: *Who shall find out his noble acts?* (Ecclesiasticus 18:4) — Ben Sira voices Job's wonder.
quote: Who shall find out his noble acts?
live_here: To whom has he given power to declare his works? and who shall find out his noble acts?

note: *Neither can the ground of them be found out* (Ecclesiasticus 18:6) — the works of the Maker beyond reach.
quote: Neither can the ground of them be found out
live_here: As for the wondrous works of Yahuah (God), there may nothing be taken from them, neither may any thing be put to them, neither can the ground of them be found out.

note: *in my mother's womb was fashioned to be flesh... being compacted in blood* (Wisdom of Solomon 7:2) — the hidden craft Job marvels at, named by the wisdom witness.
quote: in my mother's womb was fashioned to be flesh... being compacted in blood
live_here: And in my mother’s womb was fashioned to be flesh in the time of ten months, being compacted in blood, of the seed of man, and the pleasure that came with sleep.

note: *the Creator... who formed the generation of man... will also of his own mercy give you breath and life again* (2 Maccabees 7:23) — the forming hand carried past the dust to the resurrection.
quote: the Creator... who formed the generation of man... will also of his own mercy give you breath and life again
live_here: But doubtless the Creator of the world, who formed the generation of man, and found out the beginning of all things, will also of his own mercy give you breath and life again, as you now regard not your own selves for his laws’ sake.

note: Ecclesiasticus 1:2-3 — *Who can find out the height of heaven, and the breadth of the earth, and the deep, and wisdom?*; the restored wisdom-tradition echoing Job 11:8-9.
quote: Who can find out the height of heaven, and the breadth of the earth, and the deep, and wisdom?
live_here: Who can number the sand of the sea, and the drops of rain, and the days of eternity?

note: Ecclesiasticus / Sirach 1:1 — *All wisdom comes from Yahuah (God), and is with him for ever* — Ben Sira opens with Job's claim: wisdom is *with him* (12:13).
quote: All wisdom comes from Yahuah (God), and is with him for ever
live_here: All wisdom comes from Yahuah (God), and is with him for ever.

note: Ecclesiasticus (Sirach) 6:8 — *a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of your trouble*: the wisdom portrait of the fair-weather comforter who fails when trouble comes.
quote: a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of your trouble
live_here: For some man is a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of your trouble.

note: *All flesh waxeth old as a garment* (Sirach 14:17) -- Ben Sira reads the frailty as the Eden-sentence.
quote: All flesh waxeth old as a garment
live_here: All flesh waxeth old as a garment: for the covenant from the beginning is, You shall die the death.

note: *after our end there is no returning: for it is fast sealed* (Wisdom 2:5) -- the despair the tree's hope sharpens.
quote: after our end there is no returning: for it is fast sealed
live_here: For our time is a very shadow that passeth away; and after our end there is no returning: for it is fast sealed, so that no man comes again.

note: *in the death of a man there is no remedy: neither was there any man known to have returned from the grave* (Wisdom 2:1) -- the darkness honestly recorded.
quote: in the death of a man there is no remedy: neither was there any man known to have returned from the grave
live_here: For the ungodly said, reasoning with themselves, but not aright, Our life is short and tedious, and in the death of a man there is no remedy: neither was there any man known to have returned from the grave.

note: *the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her* (2 Esdras 7:32) -- the Second-Temple hope speaks Job's answer plainly.
quote: the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her
live_here: And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.

note: *the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah* (Wisdom 3:1) -- not abandoned to the grave.
quote: the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah
live_here: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.

note: *their hope full of immortality* (Wisdom 3:4) -- the desire of the Creator for the work of his hands does not die.
quote: their hope full of immortality
live_here: For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.

note: *The goods of the unjust shall be dried up like a river, and shall vanish with noise* (Ecclesiasticus / Sirach 40:13) — the wisdom witness for Zophar's *his goods shall flow away* (Job 20:28).
quote: The goods of the unjust shall be dried up like a river, and shall vanish with noise
live_here: The goods of the unjust shall be dried up like a river, and shall vanish with noise, like a great thunder in rain.

note: Ecclesiasticus 46:19 — *I have not taken any man's goods, so much as a shoe*: the library's memorial of Samuel's clean hands.
quote: I have not taken any man's goods, so much as a shoe
live_here: And before his long sleep he made protestations in the sight of Yahuah (God) and his anointed, I have not taken any man’s goods, so much as a shoe: and no man did accuse him.

note: Ecclesiasticus 46:17 — *Yahuah thundered from heaven... made his voice to be heard*: the library remembers Samuel's very thunder.
quote: Yahuah thundered from heaven... made his voice to be heard
live_here: And Yahuah (God) thundered from heaven, and with a great noise made his voice to be heard.

note: Ecclesiasticus 46:13 — *Samuel... beloved of his Elohim... by the law of Yahuah he judged*: the good and right way is the Torah-way.
quote: Samuel... beloved of his Elohim... by the law of Yahuah he judged
live_here: Samuel, the prophet of Yahuah (God), beloved of his Elohim (God), established a kingdom, and anointed princes over his people.

note: Ecclesiasticus 35:1 — *He that keepeth the law brings offerings enough:* obedience IS the offering, not its replacement.
quote: He that keepeth the law brings offerings enough:
live_here: He that keepeth the law brings offerings enough: he that takes heed to the commandment offers a peace offering.

note: Ecclesiasticus 35:2 — *he that gives alms sacrificeth praise:* righteous deeds spoken in sacrificial vocabulary, the fusion Samuel makes.
quote: he that gives alms sacrificeth praise:
live_here: He that requiteth a goodturn offers fine flour; and he that gives alms sacrificeth praise.

note: Ecclesiasticus (Sirach) 29:1 — *he that strengtheneth his hand keepeth the commandments*; merciful lending is Torah-keeping itself.
quote: he that strengtheneth his hand keepeth the commandments
live_here: He that is merciful will lend to his neighbour; and he that strengtheneth his hand keepeth the commandments.

note: Ecclesiasticus (Sirach) 29:9 — *Help the poor for the commandment's sake*; the Torah itself the reason the hand stays open.
quote: Help the poor for the commandment's sake
live_here: Help the poor for the commandment’s sake, and turn him not away because of his poverty.

note: The ungodly's creed (extras) — 'let us enjoy the good things that are present' (Wisdom of Solomon 2:6): Job's revellers with timbrel and harp.
Wisdom unmasks it (extras) — the ungodly despise that the righteous 'makes his boast that Yahuah (God) is his father' (Wisdom of Solomon 2:16): contempt for the knowledge of his ways.
Ben Sira (extras) — the secure rich man 'knoweth not what time shall come upon him... and die' (Ecclesiasticus 11:19): the reckoning laid up.
Wisdom's end (extras) — 'the hope of the ungodly is like dust that is blown away with the wind' (Wisdom of Solomon 5:14): Job's chaff and stubble, at the appointed end.
Wisdom's too-late awakening (extras) — 'This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision' (Wisdom of Solomon 5:3): the wicked face the righteous they despised.

*gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity* (Ecclesiasticus 2:5) — Ben Sira sets Job's proverb almost word for word: the righteous proved acceptable by affliction, not condemned by it.
quote: gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity
live_here: For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.

note: *he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder* (Ecclesiasticus 34:22) — the restored library names the pledge-theft of Job 24:9 for what it is: murder by inches.
quote: he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder
live_here: He that takes away his neighbour’s living slayeth him; and he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder.

note: *The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds... till the Most High shall behold to judge* (Ecclesiasticus 35:17) — Job's groan (24:12) is the cry still climbing toward a certain answer.
quote: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds... till the Most High shall behold to judge
live_here: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds: and till it come nigh, he will not be comforted; and will not depart, till the Most High shall behold to judge righteously, and execute judgment.

note: *For Yahuah (God) will not be slack... till he have struck in sunder the loins of the unmerciful* (Ecclesiasticus 35:18) — the direct answer to *Elohim (God) layeth not folly to them* (Job 24:12): not slack, only held.
quote: For Yahuah (God) will not be slack... till he have struck in sunder the loins of the unmerciful
live_here: For Yahuah (God) will not be slack, neither will the Mighty be patient toward them, till he have struck in sunder the loins of the unmerciful, and repayed vengeance to the heathen; till he have taken away the multitude of the proud, and broken the sceptre of the unrighteous;

note: *the corruptible body presseth down the soul, and the earthy tabernacle weigheth down the mind* (Wisdom of Solomon 9:15) — the creature's weight that cannot reach the purity of the Most High; the extras witness to *born of a woman* (Job 25:4).
quote: the corruptible body presseth down the soul, and the earthy tabernacle weigheth down the mind
live_here: For the corruptible body presseth down the soul, and the earthy tabernacle weigheth down the mind that museth upon many things.

note: *to deliver with a great multitude, or a small company* (1 Maccabees 3:18) — Yahudah Maccabee confesses David's creed against a mighty host.
quote: to deliver with a great multitude, or a small company
live_here: To whom Judas answered, It is no hard matter for many to be shut up in the hands of a few; and with Yahuah (God) of heaven it is all one, to deliver with a great multitude, or a small company:

note: *the victory of battle stands not in the multitude of an host; but strength comes from heaven* (1 Maccabees 3:19) — the marrow of David's word to the assembly.
quote: the victory of battle stands not in the multitude of an host; but strength comes from heaven
live_here: For the victory of battle stands not in the multitude of an host; but strength comes from heaven.

note: *Who has seen him, that he might tell us?... we have seen but a few of his works* (Sirach 43:31-32) — Ben Sira closes his creation-hymn exactly where Job does: the wonders are but a few of his works.
quote: Who has seen him, that he might tell us?... we have seen but a few of his works
live_here: Who has seen him, that he might tell us? and who can magnify him as he is?

note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:14 — *the hope of the ungodly is like dust... driven away with the storm*: the hypocrite's hope scatters when El takes his soul.
quote: the hope of the ungodly is like dust... driven away with the storm
live_here: For the hope of the ungodly is like dust that is blown away with the wind; like a thin froth that is driven away with the storm; like as the smoke which is dispersed here and there with a tempest, and passeth away as the remembrance of a guest that tarrieth but a day.

note: Ecclesiasticus 11:18-19 — *he must leave those things to others, and die*: the hoarder who never reckons his hour, exactly Job's wicked man.
quote: he must leave those things to others, and die
live_here: There is that waxeth rich by his wariness and pinching, and this is the portion of his reward:

note: Baruch 3:15 — *Who has found out her place? or who has come into her treasures?* — a near-paraphrase of Job 28:12's *where shall wisdom be found?*
quote: Who has found out her place? or who has come into her treasures?
live_here: Who has found out her place? or who has come into her treasures?

note: Baruch 3:17 — silver and gold *in which men trust* — vanished to the grave; Job 28:17 says gold and crystal cannot equal her.
quote: in which men trust
live_here: They that had their pastime with the fowls of the air, and they that hoarded up silver and gold, in which men trust, and made no end of their getting?

note: Baruch 3:30 — *Who has gone over the sea, and found her, and will bring her for pure gold?* — no one; Job 28:19, *neither shall it be valued with pure gold.*
quote: Who has gone over the sea, and found her, and will bring her for pure gold?
live_here: Who has gone over the sea, and found her, and will bring her for pure gold?

note: Sirach 1:1 — *All wisdom comes from Yahuah (God), and is with him for ever* — the one-line answer to Job 28:12.
quote: All wisdom comes from Yahuah (God), and is with him for ever
live_here: All wisdom comes from Yahuah (God), and is with him for ever.

note: Sirach 1:4 — *Wisdom has been created before all things... from everlasting* — she was already brought forth when Elohim *prepared it* (Job 28:27).
quote: Wisdom has been created before all things... from everlasting
live_here: Wisdom has been created before all things, and the understanding of prudence from everlasting.

note: *Be as a father to the fatherless... so shalt thou be as the son of the Most High.* (Sirach 4:10) — the wisdom tradition names Job's deed as the mark of a true son.
quote: Be as a father to the fatherless... so shalt thou be as the son of the Most High.
live_here: Be as a father to the fatherless, and instead of an husband to their mother: so shall you be as the son of the Most High, and he shall love you more than your mother does.

note: *Let us examine him with despitefulness and torture, that we may know his meekness, and prove his patience* (Wisdom of Solomon 2:19) — the wicked's test of the just man, the contempt Job tastes (Job 30:9).
quote: Let us examine him with despitefulness and torture, that we may know his meekness, and prove his patience
live_here: Let us examine him with despitefulness and torture, that we may know his meekness, and prove his patience.

note: *Let us condemn him with a shameful death* (Wisdom of Solomon 2:20) — the shameful end appointed for the just man by his mockers (Job 30:9).
quote: Let us condemn him with a shameful death
live_here: Let us condemn him with a shameful death: for by his own saying he shall be respected.

note: *The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds: and till it come nigh, he will not be comforted* (Ecclesiasticus 35:17) — the cry that goes uncomforted yet not abandoned (Job 30:20).
quote: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds: and till it come nigh, he will not be comforted
live_here: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds: and till it come nigh, he will not be comforted; and will not depart, till the Most High shall behold to judge righteously, and execute judgment.

note: *Let us see if his words be true: and let us prove what shall happen in the end of him* (Wisdom of Solomon 2:17) — the wicked wait to see calamity overtake the just, the darkness Job met (Job 30:26).
quote: Let us see if his words be true: and let us prove what shall happen in the end of him
live_here: Let us see if his words be true: and let us prove what shall happen in the end of him.

note: *For if the just man be the son of Yahuah (God), he will help him, and deliver him from the hand of his enemies* (Wisdom of Solomon 2:18) — the taunt that no deliverance comes, the very darkness Job waited in (Job 30:26).
quote: For if the just man be the son of Yahuah (God), he will help him, and deliver him from the hand of his enemies
live_here: For if the just man be the son of Yahuah (God), he will help him, and deliver him from the hand of his enemies.

note: *He that revengeth shall find vengeance from Yahuah (God)* (Ecclesiasticus 28:1) — Sirach's sage warns the avenger is overtaken by his own vengeance; the snare Abigail spares David.
quote: He that revengeth shall find vengeance from Yahuah (God)
live_here: He that revengeth shall find vengeance from Yahuah (God), and he will surely keep his sins in remembrance.

note: *Forgive your neighbour the hurt that he has done to you* (Ecclesiasticus 28:2) — Sirach's mercy that frees the giver; the wisdom David blesses in 1 Samuel 25:33.
quote: Forgive your neighbour the hurt that he has done to you
live_here: Forgive your neighbour the hurt that he has done to you, so shall your sins also be forgiven when you prayest.

note: *Blessed is the man that has a virtuous wife, for the number of his days shall be double* (Ecclesiasticus 26:1) — the gift Nabal squandered and David received.
quote: Blessed is the man that has a virtuous wife, for the number of his days shall be double
live_here: Blessed is the man that has a virtuous wife, for the number of his days shall be double.

note: *the grace of a wife delighteth her husband, and her discretion will fatten his bones* (Ecclesiasticus 26:13) — the discreet wife whose understanding is the strength of the house; Abigail's discretion is the whole engine of the rescue.
quote: the grace of a wife delighteth her husband, and her discretion will fatten his bones
live_here: The grace of a wife delighteth her husband, and her discretion will fatten his bones.

note: *Turn away your eye from a beautiful woman... herewith love is kindled as a fire* (Sirach 9:8) — the fathers' wisdom, with Job's own fire-image (Job 31:12).
quote: Turn away your eye from a beautiful woman... herewith love is kindled as a fire
live_here: Turn away your eye from a beautiful woman, and look not upon another’s beauty; for many have been deceived by the beauty of a woman; for herewith love is kindled as a fire.

note: *Whereas your servant works truly, entreat him not evil* (Sirach 7:20) — the fathers' wisdom: the faithful servant loved, never wronged.
quote: Whereas your servant works truly, entreat him not evil
live_here: Whereas your servant works truly, entreat him not evil, nor the hireling that bestoweth himself wholly for you.

note: *Give of your bread to the hungry, and of your garments to them that are naked* (Tobit 4:16) — the Torah's mercy in the fathers' charge.
quote: Give of your bread to the hungry, and of your garments to them that are naked
live_here: Give of your bread to the hungry, and of your garments to them that are naked; and according to your abundance give alms: and let not your eye be envious, when you give alms.

note: *deemed... the lights of heaven, to be the gods which govern the world* (Wisdom of Solomon 13:2) — the folly Job stood clear of.
quote: deemed... the lights of heaven, to be the gods which govern the world
live_here: But deemed either fire, or wind, or the swift air, or the circle of the stars, or the violent water, or the lights of heaven, to be the gods which govern the world.

note: *All wisdom comes from Yahuah (God), and is with him for ever* (Ecclesiasticus 1:1) — Ben Sira opens on Job 32:8's premise.
quote: All wisdom comes from Yahuah (God), and is with him for ever
live_here: All wisdom comes from Yahuah (God), and is with him for ever.

note: *I called upon Yahuah (God), and the spirit of wisdom came to me* (Wisdom of Solomon 7:7) — Solomon embodies wisdom asked and received, not aged into.
quote: I called upon Yahuah (God), and the spirit of wisdom came to me
live_here: Wherefore I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon Yahuah (God), and the spirit of wisdom came to me.

note: Tobit 12:15 (extras) — *Raphael... which present the prayers of the saints... before the glory*: a restored picture of the intercessor-messenger of Job 33:23, fulfilled at last in the one Mediator.
quote: Raphael... which present the prayers of the saints... before the glory
live_here: I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.

note: 2 Esdras 6:52 — the great creature reserved at the Maker's pleasure: the sovereignty of 40:19.
2 Esdras 6:52 — *have kept him to be devoured of whom you will, and when*: Leviathan reserved for the Creator's appointed judgment.
quote: have kept him to be devoured of whom you will, and when
live_here: But to Leviathan you gavest the seventh part, namely, the moist; and have kept him to be devoured of whom you will, and when.

note: ★★ *seek ye first the kingdom of Elohim (God), and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added* (Matthew 6:33) — the Messiah reorders desire as Yahuah does Baruch's: seek not great things for self, but the kingdom.

★★ *whosoever will save his life shall lose it; and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it* (Matthew 16:25) — the life grasped is lost, the life surrendered found, as Baruch's is given him for a prey.
★ *I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content* (Philippians 4:11) — Paul learned the contentment Baruch is taught: rest in what Yahuah gives, even bare life preserved.
★ *godliness with contentment is great gain* (1 Timothy 6:6) — the great thing Baruch is told NOT to seek is answered by the true great gain: godliness with contentment.
★ *And having food and raiment let us be therewith content* (1 Timothy 6:8) — Baruch's reward is bare necessity spared, his life for a prey; food and raiment, and therewith content.

★ *Yahuah (LORD) gave, and Yahuah (LORD) hath taken away; blessed be the name of Yahuah (LORD)* (Job 1:21) — Job grasps at nothing, receiving gift and loss with worship; the posture Baruch is called to.
★ *Vanity of vanities... all is vanity* (Ecclesiastes 1:2) — the Preacher names the chase that finds no rest; the cure for Baruch's restlessness is contentment, not more grasping.
*I will bring them again into the land which I promised with an oath to their fathers* (Baruch 2:34) — the exile-confession pleads the Deut 30 promise.
quote: I will bring them again into the land which I promised with an oath to their fathers
live_here: And I will bring them again into the land which I promised with an oath to their fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and they shall be lords of it: and I will increase them, and they shall not be diminished.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 7:8 — *I preferred her before sceptres and thrones, and esteemed riches nothing*: Solomon's own confession of the choice.
quote: I preferred her before sceptres and thrones, and esteemed riches nothing
live_here: I preferred her before sceptres and thrones, and esteemed riches nothing in comparison of her.

note: Wisdom of Solomon 7:11 — *All good things together came to me with her*: the riches follow the wisdom.
quote: All good things together came to me with her
live_here: All good things together came to me with her, and innumerable riches in her hands.

note: Matthew 12:42 (on 1 Kings 4:34) — *she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon*; the scene of *all kings of the earth* coming to hear is named by Yahusha (Jesus) as witness that a greater than Solomon now stands present.

★ *a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning* (Wisdom of Solomon 9:8) — the temple an earthly likeness of the heavenly pattern, never a container for the uncontainable (1 Kings 8:27).
quote: a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning
live_here: You have commanded me to build a temple upon your holy mount, and an altar in the city in which you dwellest, a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning.

note: ★ *Many nations shall come from far to the name of Yahuah (God)* (Tobit 13:11) — the far country of Solomon's stranger becomes the many nations drawn to the Name (1 Kings 8:43).
quote: Many nations shall come from far to the name of Yahuah (God)
live_here: Many nations shall come from far to the name of Yahuah (God) with gifts in their hands, even gifts to the King of heaven; all generations shall praise you with great joy.

note: *all nations shall turn, and fear Yahuah (God) truly, and shall bury their idols* (Tobit 14:6) — the Name made known is not tolerance of idols but their burial; the nations come to fear the one El (1 Kings 8:43).
quote: all nations shall turn, and fear Yahuah (God) truly, and shall bury their idols
live_here: And all nations shall turn, and fear Yahuah (God) truly, and shall bury their idols.

note: *all nations shall praise Yahuah (God), and his people shall confess Yahuah (God), and Yahuah (God) shall exalt his people* (Tobit 14:7) — the ingathering of the stranger does not displace the people; both rejoice (1 Kings 8:43).
quote: all nations shall praise Yahuah (God), and his people shall confess Yahuah (God), and Yahuah (God) shall exalt his people
live_here: So shall all nations praise Yahuah (God), and his people shall confess Yahuah (God), and Yahuah (God) shall exalt his people; and all those which love Yahuah (God) in truth and justice shall rejoice, shewing mercy to our brothers.

note: ★★ *in the land of their captivities they shall remember themselves* (Baruch 2:30) — Baruch's *remember themselves* is Solomon's *bethink themselves* (1 Kings 8:47); the first stirring of repentance in exile.
quote: in the land of their captivities they shall remember themselves
live_here: For I knew that they would not hear me, because it is a stiffnecked people: but in the land of their captivities they shall remember themselves.

note: ★ *I will bring them again into the land which I promised with an oath to their fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob* (Baruch 2:34) — the oath-bound regathering, the paternal covenant line gathered home and increased (1 Kings 8:48).
quote: I will bring them again into the land which I promised with an oath to their fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
live_here: And I will bring them again into the land which I promised with an oath to their fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and they shall be lords of it: and I will increase them, and they shall not be diminished.
